ko.title: 후보를 넘어: 11월 주 주민투표가 정책을 형성하는 방법

segments.src: When Americans head to the polls in November, the biggest names on the ticket will be candidates for the Senate, the House and governor's offices.
segments.tr: 11월에 미국 유권자들이 투표소로 향할 때, 투표용지에서 가장 비중 있는 이름들은 상원, 하원, 주지사 후보들이 될 것입니다.

segments.src: But look further down the ballot and many voters will find something different: questions that ask them to decide a policy directly.
segments.tr: 하지만 투표용지 아래쪽을 더 살펴보면 많은 유권자들이 다른 무언가를 발견하게 됩니다. 바로 정책을 직접 결정하도록 묻는 질문들입니다.

segments.src: Ballot measures can raise the minimum wage, change how taxes are collected, rewrite election rules or amend a state constitution, and the outcomes often have a more immediate effect on daily life than a single seat in a legislature.
segments.tr: 주민투표는 최저임금을 인상하고, 세금 징수 방식을 바꾸며, 선거 규정을 다시 쓰거나 주 헌법을 개정할 수 있으며, 그 결과는 종종 입법부의 단일 의석보다 일상생활에 훨씬 더 즉각적인 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## 주민투표란 무엇인가요?

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: 주민투표는 선출직 공무원이 아니라 유권자들에게 직접 던져지는 질문입니다.

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: 주에 따라 이는 발의안(proposition), 질문(question), 개정안(amendment) 또는 국민투표(referendum)라고 불릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: 표현은 다르지만 개념은 동일합니다. "찬성" 또는 "반대" 투표를 통해 법률이나 주 헌법을 바꿀 수 있다는 점입니다.

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: 주민투표는 일반적으로 몇 가지 범주로 나뉩니다:

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **시민 발의 법률(Initiated statutes):** 시민들이 새로운 법률을 제안하고, 요건을 충족할 만큼의 서명을 모으며, 유권자들이 이를 승인하거나 거부합니다.

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **시민 발의 헌법 개정안(Initiated constitutional amendments):** 이를 허용하는 주에서 시민들이 동일한 서명 절차를 거쳐 주 헌법 변경을 제안합니다.

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **입법부 회부 안건(Legislative referrals):** 입법부가 제안된 법률이나 헌법 개정안을 투표용지에 올립니다. 대부분의 주에서 헌법 개정안은 발효되기 전에 유권자의 동의를 거쳐야 합니다.

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **거부권 국민투표(Veto referendums):** 입법부가 이미 통과시킨 법률을 유지해야 하는지 여부를 유권자들에게 묻기 위해 시민들이 서명을 수집합니다.

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## 안건이 투표용지에 오르는 과정

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: 규정은 주마다 매우 다양합니다.

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: 주의 절반 정도가 시민 발의 안건의 형태를 허용하는 반면, 모든 주는 어떤 형태로든 입법부 회부 안건을 사용합니다.

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: 시민 발의가 허용되는 곳에서는 지지자들이 일반적으로 다음을 수행해야 합니다:

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **청원서 제출:** 주 정부 사무실에 제안서의 정확한 문구를 포함하여 청원서를 제출합니다.

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: 2. **공식 명칭 및 요약 수령:** 이는 유권자유권자들이 나중에 보게 될 문구입니다. 이 문구는 때때로 법적 분쟁의 대상이 됩니다.

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **유권자 서명 수집:** 등록된 유권자들로부터 서명을 받습니다. 필요한 서명 수는 종종 이전 선거의 투표율과 연계되어 있으며, 일부 주는 지역별로 서명이 분산될 것을 요구하기도 합니다.

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **검증 통과:** 선거 관리들이 서명을 확인하며, 안건은 인증되기 전에 법원의 심사를 거칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: 이러한 과정 때문에 선거 캠페인은 종종 선거일보다 1년 이상 일찍 시작됩니다.

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: 서명 운동은 비용이 많이 들 수 있으며, 문구, 주제, 서명 유효성을 둘러싼 법적 공방에 따라 안건이 투표용지에 오를지 여부가 결정될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Issues Voters Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## 유권자들이 저울질하는 주요 쟁점들

segments.src: Ballot measures tend to cluster around a handful of recurring subjects.
segments.tr: 주민투표는 몇 가지 반복되는 주제를 중심으로 모이는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Several categories are common in many election cycles.
segments.tr: 여러 범주가 많은 선거 주기에서 공통적으로 나타납니다.

segments.src: ### Wages and Workplace Rules
segments.tr: ### 임금과 직장 규정

segments.src: Minimum wage proposals have appeared on ballots in many states, along with questions about paid sick leave and tipped-worker pay.
segments.tr: 최저임금 제안은 유급 병가 및 팁을 받는 근로자 임금에 관한 질문과 함께 많은 주의 투표용지에 등장했습니다.

segments.src: Because wage rules affect household budgets and business costs at the same time, these measures draw attention from both employees and employers.
segments.tr: 임금 규정은 가계 예산과 기업 비용에 동시에 영향을 미치기 때문에, 이러한 안건들은 근로자와 고용주 모두의 관심을 끌어모읍니다.

segments.src: ### Taxes and Budgets
segments.tr: ### 세금과 예산

segments.src: Voters are frequently asked to approve or reject changes to property, income or sales taxes, to set limits on government spending, or to authorize bonds for schools, roads and other public projects.
segments.tr: 유권자들은 재산세, 소득세, 판매세의 변경을 승인 또는 거부하거나, 정부 지출에 한도를 설정하거나, 학교, 도로 및 기타 공공 프로젝트를 위한 채권을 승인해 달라는 요청을 자주 받습니다.

segments.src: These questions often come with detailed fiscal analyses prepared by nonpartisan state agencies.
segments.tr: 이러한 질문들에는 종종 당파색이 없는 주 기관들이 작성한 상세한 재정 분석이 동반됩니다.

segments.src: ### Election Rules
segments.tr: ### 선거 규정

segments.src: Some of the most closely watched measures concern the process of voting itself.
segments.tr: 가장 면밀히 주시되는 안건 중 일부는 투표 과정 자체와 관련이 있습니다.

segments.src: Topics have included voter identification requirements, ranked-choice voting, open primaries, redistricting commissions and campaign finance rules.
segments.tr: 주제에는 유권자 신분증 요건, 순위선호투표제, 개방형 예비선거, 선거구 획정 위원회, 선거 자금 규정 등이 포함되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: Since these measures set the framework for future elections, they can shape which candidates compete and how votes are counted.
segments.tr: 이러한 안건들은 미래 선거의 틀을 설정하기 때문에, 어떤 후보가 경쟁하고 표가 어떻게 집계되는지에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Other Policy Areas
segments.tr: ### 기타 정책 분야

segments.src: Housing, health care, public safety, education funding and environmental policy also regularly appear.
segments.tr: 주택, 의료, 공공 안전, 교육 자금 및 환경 정책도 정기적으로 등장합니다.

segments.src: Individual states may also present highly local questions that never become national news.
segments.tr: 개별 주에서는 국가적인 뉴스가 되지 않는 매우 지역적인 질문들을 제시할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why These Measures Can Matter as Much as Any Candidate
segments.tr: ## 이러한 안건이 어떤 후보 못지않게 중요할 수 있는 이유

segments.src: A single legislator is one vote among many.
segments.tr: 단일 입법자는 수많은 표 중의 한 표일 뿐입니다.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, can become law or a constitutional provision on its own once voters approve it.
segments.tr: 반면에 주민투표는 유권자들이 일단 승인하면 그 자체로 법률이나 헌법 조항이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That has several consequences:
segments.tr: 이는 몇 가지 결과를 낳습니다:

segments.src: - **Direct and durable change.** A constitutional amendment can be difficult to undo, since reversing it often requires another statewide vote.
segments.tr: - **직접적이고 지속적인 변화:** 헌법 개정안은 되돌리려면 종종 또 다른 주 전체의 투표가 필요하기 때문에 폐기하기 어려울 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Policy outside the legislature.** Voters can act on topics that lawmakers have been unwilling or unable to address, or can reject proposals the legislature has passed.
segments.tr: - **입법부를 우회하는 정책:** 유권자들은 입법부가 다루기를 꺼렸거나 다루지 못했던 주제에 대해 행동할 수 있으며, 입법부가 통과시킨 제안을 거부할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Influence on turnout.** High-profile measures can motivate people to vote who might otherwise skip a midterm election.
segments.tr: - **투표율에 대한 영향력:** 이목을끄는 안건들은 자칫 중간선거를 건너뛸 수 있는 사람들에게 투표 동기를 부여할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Successful measures in one state are often studied and copied by advocates in others.
segments.tr: - **파급 효과:** 한 주의 성공적인 안건은 다른 주의 지지자들에게 종종 연구되고 모방됩니다.

segments.src: ## How to Prepare as a Voter
segments.tr: ## 유권자로서 준비하는 방법

segments.src: Ballot measures can be dense, and the wording is not always easy to follow.
segments.tr: 주민투표는 내용이 방대할 수 있으며, 문구가 항상 이해하기 쉬운 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 습관이 도움이 됩니다:

segments.src: - **Read the full text and the official summary,** not just the title. Official voter guides, usually published by the secretary of state or election office, include the exact language and arguments for and against.
segments.tr: - **제목뿐만 아니라 전체 텍스트와 공식 요약 읽기:** 보통 주 장관실이나 선거 관리국에서 발행하는 공식 유권자 안내서에는 찬반 양측의 정확한 표현과 논거가 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Check the fiscal analysis.** Many states publish independent estimates of what a measure would cost or save.
segments.tr: - **재정 분석 확인:** 많은 주에서는 안건에 드는 비용이나 절감되는 금액에 대한 독립적인 추산치를 발표합니다.

segments.src: - **Understand what "yes" and "no" mean.** On some measures, a "yes" vote keeps current law while a "no" vote changes it, or the reverse. The wording can be counterintuitive.
segments.tr: - **"찬성"과 "반대"가 의미하는 바 이해하기:** 일부 안건에서는 "찬성" 투표가 현행법을 유지하는 반면 "반대" 투표가 이를 바꾸거나, 그 반대가 되기도 합니다. 문구가 직관적이지 않을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Look at who is funding each side.** State campaign finance databases list major donors for and against a measure.
segments.tr: - **누가 각 진영에 자금을 대고 있는지 살펴보기:** 주 선거 자금 데이터베이스에는 안건 찬반 양측의 주요 기부자들이 나열되어 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Use trusted, nonpartisan sources.** Local newsrooms, nonpartisan research organizations and official state publications can help separate the facts from campaign advertising.
segments.tr: - **신뢰할 수 있는 비당파적 출처 이용하기:** 지역 언론사, 비당파적 연구 단체, 공식 주 정부 간행물은 사실과 선거 광고를 구분하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote the whole ballot.** Some voters leave ballot questions blank, a practice known as "ballot roll-off." Reviewing a sample ballot ahead of time can make it easier to decide.
segments.tr: - **전체 투표용지에 대해 투표할 계획 세우기:** 일부 유권자들은 투표용지의 질문들을 빈칸으로 남겨두는데, 이는 "투표 이탈(ballot roll-off)"로 알려진 관행입니다. 사전에 견본 투표용지를 검토해 보면 결정을 내리는 데 더 수월할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 핵심 결론

segments.src: Campaign coverage naturally focuses on candidates, but the ballot is often much longer than the headlines suggest.
segments.tr: 선거 보도는 자연스럽게 후보자들에게 초점을 맞추지만, 투표용지는 헤드라인이 시사하는 것보다 훨씬 더 긴 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Taking time to learn about the questions that appear on your own ballot is one of the most direct ways to have a say in the rules, taxes and policies that affect your state.
segments.tr: 자신의 투표용지에 나타나는 질문들에 대해 알아가는 시간을 갖는 것은 우리 주의 규칙, 세금, 정책에 목소리를 낼 수 있는 가장 직접적인 방법 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Check your local election office for a sample ballot and voter guide, and confirm your registration status and voting options well before Election Day.
segments.tr: 선거일 훨씬 전에 지역 선거 관리 사무소에서 견본 투표용지와 유권자 안내서를 확인하고, 등록 상태와 투표 옵션을 재확인하십시오.

zh.title: 超越候选人：11月的州投票提案如何塑造政策

segments.src: When Americans head to the polls in November, the biggest names on the ticket will be candidates for the Senate, the House and governor's offices.
segments.tr: 当美国人在11月前往投票站时，选票上最引人注目的名字将是参议院、众议院和州长职位的候选人。

segments.src: But look further down the ballot and many voters will find something different: questions that ask them to decide a policy directly.
segments.tr: 但如果仔细查看选票下方，许多选民会发现一些不同的东西：直接要求他们决定某项政策的问题。

segments.src: Ballot measures can raise the minimum wage, change how taxes are collected, rewrite election rules or amend a state constitution, and the outcomes often have a more immediate effect on daily life than a single seat in a legislature.
segments.tr: 投票提案可以提高最低工资、改变税收征收方式、重写选举规则或修改州宪法，其结果往往比立法机构中的单一席位对日常生活产生更直接的影响。

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## 什么是投票提案？

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: 投票提案是直接提交给选民而非民选官员的问题。

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: 根据州的不同，它可能被称为提案（proposition）、问题（question）、修正案（amendment）或公投（referendum）。

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: 措辞虽有不同，但理念是一样的：“赞成”或“反对”的投票可以改变法律或州宪法。

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: 投票提案通常分为几类：

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **公民倡议法规（Initiated statutes）：** 公民提出一项新法律，收集足够的签名以获得资格，然后由选民批准或否决。

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **公民倡议宪法修正案（Initiated constitutional amendments）：** 在允许的州，公民通过同样的签名程序提出对州宪法的修改。

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **立法机关转交提案（Legislative referrals）：** 立法机关将拟议的法律或宪法修正案提交选票。在大多数州，宪法修正案在生效前必须提交给选民。

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **否决公投（Veto referendums）：** 公民收集签名，询问选民立法机关已经通过的法律是否应继续有效。

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## 提案如何进入选票

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: 各州的规则差异很大。

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: 大约一半的州允许某种形式的公民倡议提案，而每个州都以某种形式使用立法机关转交提案。

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: 在允许公民倡议的地方，支持者通常必须：

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **向州政府办公室提交请愿书**，通常包括提案的准确文本。

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: 2. **获得官方标题和摘要**，这是选民最终会看到的语言。这种措辞有时是法律纠纷的主题。

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **从注册选民那里收集签名**。所需数量通常与前一次选举的投票率挂钩，一些州还要求签名必须分布在不同地区。

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **通过验证**，选举官员会检查签名，提案在获得认证前可能会面临法院审查。

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: 由于这一过程，竞选活动通常在选举日前一年多就开始了。

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: 签名征集活动可能代价高昂，而关于措辞、主题或签名有效性的法律挑战可能会决定一项提案是否最终出现在选票上。

segments.src: ## The Issues Voters Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## 选民正在权衡的问题

segments.src: Ballot measures tend to cluster around a handful of recurring subjects.
segments.tr: 投票提案往往集中在少数几个反复出现的主题上。

segments.src: Several categories are common in many election cycles.
segments.tr: 几个类别在许多选举周期中都很常见。

segments.src: ### Wages and Workplace Rules
segments.tr: ### 工资和工作场所规则

segments.src: Minimum wage proposals have appeared on ballots in many states, along with questions about paid sick leave and tipped-worker pay.
segments.tr: 最低工资提案已出现在许多州的选票上，同时还有关于带薪病假和小费工工资的问题。

segments.src: Because wage rules affect household budgets and business costs at the same time, these measures draw attention from both employees and employers.
segments.tr: 由于工资规则同时影响家庭预算和企业成本，这些措施引起了雇员和雇主的关注。

segments.src: ### Taxes and Budgets
segments.tr: ### 税收和预算

segments.src: Voters are frequently asked to approve or reject changes to property, income or sales taxes, to set limits on government spending, or to authorize bonds for schools, roads and other public projects.
segments.tr: 选民经常被要求批准或否决对财产税、所得税或销售税的修改，设定政府支出限制，或授权为学校、道路和其他公共项目发行债券。

segments.src: These questions often come with detailed fiscal analyses prepared by nonpartisan state agencies.
segments.tr: 这些问题通常附有由无党派州政府机构准备的详细财政分析。

segments.src: ### Election Rules
segments.tr: ### 选举规则

segments.src: Some of the most closely watched measures concern the process of voting itself.
segments.tr: 一些最受关注的提案涉及投票过程本身。

segments.src: Topics have included voter identification requirements, ranked-choice voting, open primaries, redistricting commissions and campaign finance rules.
segments.tr: 主题包括选民身份要求、排序复选投票（ranked-choice voting）、开放式初选、选区重划委员会和竞选财务规则。

segments.src: Since these measures set the framework for future elections, they can shape which candidates compete and how votes are counted.
segments.tr: 由于这些措施为未来的选举设定了框架，它们可以塑造哪些候选人参与竞争以及选票如何计算。

segments.src: ### Other Policy Areas
segments.tr: ### 其他政策领域

segments.src: Housing, health care, public safety, education funding and environmental policy also regularly appear.
segments.tr: 住房、医疗保健、公共安全、教育资金和环境政策也经常出现。

segments.src: Individual states may also present highly local questions that never become national news.
segments.tr: 个别州也可能提出非常本地化的问题，这些问题永远不会成为全国性新闻。

segments.src: ## Why These Measures Can Matter as Much as Any Candidate
segments.tr: ## 为什么这些提案可能与任何候选人一样重要

segments.src: A single legislator is one vote among many.
segments.tr: 单一立法者只是众多投票中的一票。

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, can become law or a constitutional provision on its own once voters approve it.
segments.tr: 相比之下，投票提案一旦获得选民批准，本身就可以成为法律或宪法条款。

segments.src: That has several consequences:
segments.tr: 这有几个后果：

segments.src: - **Direct and durable change.** A constitutional amendment can be difficult to undo, since reversing it often requires another statewide vote.
segments.tr: - **直接且持久的改变。** 宪法修正案可能难以撤销，因为推翻它通常需要另一次全州范围的投票。

segments.src: - **Policy outside the legislature.** Voters can act on topics that lawmakers have been unwilling or unable to address, or can reject proposals the legislature has passed.
segments.tr: - **立法机构之外的政策。** 选民可以对立法者不愿或无法解决的主题采取行动，或者可以否决立法机构已经通过的提案。

segments.src: - **Influence on turnout.** High-profile measures can motivate people to vote who might otherwise skip a midterm election.
segments.tr: - **对投票率的影响。** 高调的提案可以激励那些原本可能跳过中期选举的人去投票。

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Successful measures in one state are often studied and copied by advocates in others.
segments.tr: - **连锁反应。** 一个州成功的提案经常被其他州的倡导者研究和效仿。

segments.src: ## How to Prepare as a Voter
segments.tr: ## 作为选民如何准备

segments.src: Ballot measures can be dense, and the wording is not always easy to follow.
segments.tr: 投票提案可能很晦涩，措辞并不总是容易理解。

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: 养成几个习惯会有所帮助：

segments.src: - **Read the full text and the official summary,** not just the title. Official voter guides, usually published by the secretary of state or election office, include the exact language and arguments for and against.
segments.tr: - **阅读全文和官方摘要，** 而不仅仅是标题。官方选民指南（通常由州务卿或选举办公室发布）包括准确的语言以及支持和反对的论点。

segments.src: - **Check the fiscal analysis.** Many states publish independent estimates of what a measure would cost or save.
segments.tr: - **查看财政分析。** 许多州发布关于某项提案将花费多少或节省多少的独立估算。

segments.src: - **Understand what "yes" and "no" mean.** On some measures, a "yes" vote keeps current law while a "no" vote changes it, or the reverse. The wording can be counterintuitive.
segments.tr: - **理解“赞成”和“反对”的含义。** 在某些提案上，“赞成”票保留现行法律，而“反对”票则改变它，反之亦然。措辞可能违反直觉。

segments.src: - **Look at who is funding each side.** State campaign finance databases list major donors for and against a measure.
segments.tr: - **查看谁在资助每一方。** 州竞选财务数据库列出了支持和反对某项提案的主要捐助者。

segments.src: - **Use trusted, nonpartisan sources.** Local newsrooms, nonpartisan research organizations and official state publications can help separate the facts from campaign advertising.
segments.tr: - **使用可信的、无党派的来源。** 当地新闻编辑室、无党派研究组织和官方州出版物可以帮助将事实与竞选广告区分开来。

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote the whole ballot.** Some voters leave ballot questions blank, a practice known as "ballot roll-off." Reviewing a sample ballot ahead of time can make it easier to decide.
segments.tr: - **计划投出完整的选票。** 一些选民将选票问题留空，这种做法被称为“选票流失”（ballot roll-off）。提前查看样本选票可以更容易做出决定。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: Campaign coverage naturally focuses on candidates, but the ballot is often much longer than the headlines suggest.
segments.tr: 竞选报道自然关注候选人，但选票往往比头条新闻所暗示的要长得多。

segments.src: Taking time to learn about the questions that appear on your own ballot is one of the most direct ways to have a say in the rules, taxes and policies that affect your state.
segments.tr: 花时间了解出现在你选票上的问题，是影响你所在州的规则、税收和政策的最直接方式之一。

segments.src: Check your local election office for a sample ballot and voter guide, and confirm your registration status and voting options well before Election Day.
segments.tr: 在选举日前，请向当地选举办公室查询样本选票和选民指南，并确认你的注册状态和投票选项。

hi.title: उम्मीदवारों से परे: नवंबर में राज्य जनमत संग्रह नीति को कैसे आकार देते हैं

segments.src: When Americans head to the polls in November, the biggest names on the ticket will be candidates for the Senate, the House and governor's offices.
segments.tr: जब अमेरिकी नवंबर में मतदान करने जाते हैं, तो मतपत्र पर सबसे बड़े नाम सीनेट, हाउस और गवर्नर के कार्यालयों के उम्मीदवार होंगे।

segments.src: But look further down the ballot and many voters will find something different: questions that ask them to decide a policy directly.
segments.tr: लेकिन मतपत्र पर थोड़ा नीचे देखें और कई मतदाताओं को कुछ अलग मिलेगा: ऐसे प्रश्न जो उनसे सीधे नीति तय करने के लिए कहते हैं।

segments.src: Ballot measures can raise the minimum wage, change how taxes are collected, rewrite election rules or amend a state constitution, and the outcomes often have a more immediate effect on daily life than a single seat in a legislature.
segments.tr: जनमत संग्रह न्यूनतम वेतन बढ़ा सकते हैं, करों के संग्रह के तरीके को बदल सकते हैं, चुनाव नियमों को दोबारा लिख सकते हैं या राज्य के संविधान में संशोधन कर सकते हैं, और इसके परिणाम अक्सर विधायिका में एक सीट की तुलना में दैनिक जीवन पर अधिक तात्कालिक प्रभाव डालते हैं।

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## जनमत संग्रह क्या है?

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: जनमत संग्रह एक ऐसा प्रश्न है जो चुने हुए अधिकारियों के बजाय सीधे मतदाताओं के सामने रखा जाता है।

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: राज्य के आधार पर, इसे एक प्रस्ताव, एक प्रश्न, एक संशोधन या एक जनमत संग्रह कहा जा सकता है।

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: शब्दों का चयन अलग होता है, लेकिन विचार समान है: "हाँ" या "ना" का वोट किसी कानून या राज्य के संविधान को बदल सकता है।

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: जनमत संग्रह आम तौर पर कुछ श्रेणियों में आते हैं:

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **नागरिक-प्रस्तावित कानून:** नागरिक एक नए कानून का प्रस्ताव करते हैं, अर्हता प्राप्त करने के लिए पर्याप्त हस्ताक्षर एकत्र करते हैं, और मतदाता इसे स्वीकृत या अस्वीकृत करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **नागरिक-प्रस्तावित संवैधानिक संशोधन:** नागरिक इसे अनुमति देने वाले राज्यों में समान हस्ताक्षर प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से राज्य के संविधान में बदलाव का प्रस्ताव करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **विधायी रेफरल:** विधायिका मतपत्र पर एक प्रस्तावित कानून या संवैधानिक संशोधन रखती है। अधिकांश राज्यों में, संवैधानिक संशोधनों के प्रभावी होने से पहले उन्हें मतदाताओं के पास जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **वीटो जनमत संग्रह:** नागरिक यह पूछने के लिए हस्ताक्षर एकत्र करते हैं कि क्या विधायिका द्वारा पहले ही पारित किए गए कानून को प्रभावी रहना चाहिए।

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## उपाय मतपत्र पर कैसे आते हैं

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: नियम एक राज्य से दूसरे राज्य में काफी भिन्न होते हैं।

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: लगभग आधे राज्य नागरिक-प्रस्तावित उपाय के कुछ रूपों की अनुमति देते हैं, जबकि प्रत्येक राज्य किसी न किसी रूप में विधायी रेफरल का उपयोग करता है।

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: जहाँ नागरिक पहलों की अनुमति है, समर्थकों को आम तौर पर यह करना होगा:

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **एक याचिका दाखिल करें** राज्य कार्यालय के साथ, जिसमें अक्सर प्रस्ताव का सटीक पाठ शामिल होता है।

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: 2. **एक आधिकारिक शीर्षक और सारांश प्राप्त करें**, जो वह भाषा है जिसे मतदाता अंततः देखेंगे। यह शब्दावली कभी-कभी कानूनी विवादों का विषय होती है।

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **पंजीकृत मतदाताओं से हस्ताक्षर एकत्र करें**। आवश्यक संख्या अक्सर पिछले चुनाव में मतदान से जुड़ी होती है, और कुछ राज्यों में यह भी आवश्यक होता है कि हस्ताक्षर विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में फैले हों।

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **सत्यापन पास करें**, जिसमें चुनाव अधिकारी हस्ताक्षर की जांच करते हैं और प्रमाणित होने से पहले उपाय को अदालत की समीक्षा का सामना करना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: इस प्रक्रिया के कारण, अभियान अक्सर चुनाव के दिन से एक साल पहले शुरू होते हैं।

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: हस्ताक्षर अभियान महंगे हो सकते हैं, और शब्दावली, विषय वस्तु या हस्ताक्षर की वैधता पर कानूनी चुनौतियाँ यह तय कर सकती हैं कि कोई उपाय मतपत्र पर दिखाई देता है या नहीं।

segments.src: ## The Issues Voters Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## वे मुद्दे जिन पर मतदाता विचार कर रहे हैं

segments.src: Ballot measures tend to cluster around a handful of recurring subjects.
segments.tr: जनमत संग्रह कुछ बार-बार आने वाले विषयों के आसपास केंद्रित होते हैं।

segments.src: Several categories are common in many election cycles.
segments.tr: कई चुनाव चक्रों में कई श्रेणियां आम हैं।

segments.src: ### Wages and Workplace Rules
segments.tr: ### वेतन और कार्यस्थल के नियम

segments.src: Minimum wage proposals have appeared on ballots in many states, along with questions about paid sick leave and tipped-worker pay.
segments.tr: वेतन अवकाश और टिप-पाने वाले श्रमिकों के वेतन के बारे में प्रश्नों के साथ-साथ न्यूनतम वेतन प्रस्ताव कई राज्यों में मतपत्रों पर दिखाई दिए हैं।

segments.src: Because wage rules affect household budgets and business costs at the same time, these measures draw attention from both employees and employers.
segments.tr: चूँकि वेतन नियम एक ही समय में घरेलू बजट और व्यावसायिक लागत को प्रभावित करते हैं, इसलिए ये उपाय कर्मचारियों और नियोक्ताओं दोनों का ध्यान आकर्षित करते हैं।

segments.src: ### Taxes and Budgets
segments.tr: ### कर और बजट

segments.src: Voters are frequently asked to approve or reject changes to property, income or sales taxes, to set limits on government spending, or to authorize bonds for schools, roads and other public projects.
segments.tr: मतदाताओं से अक्सर संपत्ति, आय या बिक्री करों में परिवर्तन को मंजूरी देने या अस्वीकार करने, सरकारी खर्च पर सीमा तय करने, या स्कूलों, सड़कों और अन्य सार्वजनिक परियोजनाओं के लिए बांड को अधिकृत करने के लिए कहा जाता है।

segments.src: These questions often come with detailed fiscal analyses prepared by nonpartisan state agencies.
segments.tr: इन प्रश्नों के साथ अक्सर गैर-पक्षपातपूर्ण राज्य एजेंसियों द्वारा तैयार किए गए विस्तृत राजकोषीय विश्लेषण होते हैं।

segments.src: ### Election Rules
segments.tr: ### चुनाव के नियम

segments.src: Some of the most closely watched measures concern the process of voting itself.
segments.tr: सबसे करीबी से देखे जाने वाले उपायों में से कुछ मतदान की प्रक्रिया से ही संबंधित हैं।

segments.src: Topics have included voter identification requirements, ranked-choice voting, open primaries, redistricting commissions and campaign finance rules.
segments.tr: विषयों में मतदाता पहचान आवश्यकताएँ, रैंक-पसंद मतदान, खुली प्राथमिक, पुनर्जिलेबंदी आयोग और अभियान वित्त नियम शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Since these measures set the framework for future elections, they can shape which candidates compete and how votes are counted.
segments.tr: चूँकि ये उपाय भविष्य के चुनावों के लिए रूपरेखा तैयार करते हैं, इसलिए वे यह आकार दे सकते हैं कि कौन से उम्मीदवार प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं और वोटों की गिनती कैसे की जाती है।

segments.src: ### Other Policy Areas
segments.tr: ### अन्य नीतिगत क्षेत्र

segments.src: Housing, health care, public safety, education funding and environmental policy also regularly appear.
segments.tr: आवास, स्वास्थ्य देखभाल, सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा, शिक्षा वित्त पोषण और पर्यावरण नीति भी नियमित रूप से दिखाई देते हैं।

segments.src: Individual states may also present highly local questions that never become national news.
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत राज्य अत्यधिक स्थानीय प्रश्न भी प्रस्तुत कर सकते हैं जो कभी राष्ट्रीय समाचार नहीं बनते।

segments.src: ## Why These Measures Can Matter as Much as Any Candidate
segments.tr: ## ये उपाय किसी भी उम्मीदवार जितने महत्वपूर्ण क्यों हो सकते हैं

segments.src: A single legislator is one vote among many.
segments.tr: एक अकेला विधायक कई लोगों में से एक वोट है।

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, can become law or a constitutional provision on its own once voters approve it.
segments.tr: इसके विपरीत, एक जनमत संग्रह मतदाताओं के स्वीकृत होने के बाद अपने दम पर कानून या संवैधानिक प्रावधान बन सकता है।

segments.src: That has several consequences:
segments.tr: इसके कई परिणाम हैं:

segments.src: - **Direct and durable change.** A constitutional amendment can be difficult to undo, since reversing it often requires another statewide vote.
segments.tr: - **प्रत्यक्ष और स्थायी परिवर्तन।** एक संवैधानिक संशोधन को पूर्ववत करना मुश्किल हो सकता है, क्योंकि इसे पलटने के लिए अक्सर एक और राज्यव्यापी वोट की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: - **Policy outside the legislature.** Voters can act on topics that lawmakers have been unwilling or unable to address, or can reject proposals the legislature has passed.
segments.tr: - **विधायिका के बाहर नीति।** मतदाता उन विषयों पर कार्रवाई कर सकते हैं जिन्हें संबोधित करने के लिए कानून निर्माता अनिच्छुक या असमर्थ रहे हैं, या विधायिका द्वारा पारित प्रस्तावों को अस्वीकार कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Influence on turnout.** High-profile measures can motivate people to vote who might otherwise skip a midterm election.
segments.tr: - **मतदान पर प्रभाव।** हाई-प्रोफाइल उपाय उन लोगों को वोट देने के लिए प्रेरित कर सकते हैं जो अन्यथा मध्यावधि चुनाव छोड़ सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Successful measures in one state are often studied and copied by advocates in others.
segments.tr: - **लहर प्रभाव।** एक राज्य में सफल उपायों का अध्ययन अक्सर दूसरों में अधिवक्ताओं द्वारा किया जाता है और उनकी नकल की जाती है।

segments.src: ## How to Prepare as a Voter
segments.tr: ## एक मतदाता के रूप में कैसे तैयारी करें

segments.src: Ballot measures can be dense, and the wording is not always easy to follow.
segments.tr: जनमत संग्रह सघन हो सकते हैं, और शब्दावली हमेशा पालन करने में आसान नहीं होती है।

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: कुछ आदतें मदद करती हैं:

segments.src: - **Read the full text and the official summary,** not just the title. Official voter guides, usually published by the secretary of state or election office, include the exact language and arguments for and against.
segments.tr: - **पूर्ण पाठ और आधिकारिक सारांश पढ़ें,** केवल शीर्षक नहीं। आधिकारिक मतदाता गाइड, आमतौर पर राज्य के सचिव या चुनाव कार्यालय द्वारा प्रकाशित, में सटीक भाषा और पक्ष और विपक्ष के तर्क शामिल होते हैं।

segments.src: - **Check the fiscal analysis.** Many states publish independent estimates of what a measure would cost or save.
segments.tr: - **राजकोषीय विश्लेषण की जाँच करें।** कई राज्य स्वतंत्र अनुमान प्रकाशित करते हैं कि किसी उपाय की लागत क्या होगी या क्या बचत होगी।

segments.src: - **Understand what "yes" and "no" mean.** On some measures, a "yes" vote keeps current law while a "no" vote changes it, or the reverse. The wording can be counterintuitive.
segments.tr: - **समझें कि "हाँ" और "ना" का क्या अर्थ है।** कुछ उपायों पर, "हाँ" वोट वर्तमान कानून को रखता है जबकि "ना" वोट इसे बदलता है, या इसके विपरीत। शब्दावली काउंटरइंट्यूइटी हो सकती है।

segments.src: - **Look at who is funding each side.** State campaign finance databases list major donors for and against a measure.
segments.tr: - **देखें कि प्रत्येक पक्ष को कौन वित्त पोषण दे रहा है।** राज्य अभियान वित्त डेटाबेस किसी उपाय के पक्ष और विपक्ष में प्रमुख दाताओं को सूचीबद्ध करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Use trusted, nonpartisan sources.** Local newsrooms, nonpartisan research organizations and official state publications can help separate the facts from campaign advertising.
segments.tr: - **विश्वसनीय, गैर-पक्षपातपूर्ण स्रोतों का उपयोग करें।** स्थानीय समाचार कक्ष, गैर-पक्षपातपूर्ण अनुसंधान संगठन और आधिकारिक राज्य प्रकाशन अभियान विज्ञापन से तथ्यों को अलग करने में मदद कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote the whole ballot.** Some voters leave ballot questions blank, a practice known as "ballot roll-off." Reviewing a sample ballot ahead of time can make it easier to decide.
segments.tr: - **पूरे मतपत्र पर मतदान करने की योजना बनाएं।** कुछ मतदाता मतपत्र के प्रश्नों को खाली छोड़ देते हैं, जिसे "बैलट रोल-ऑफ़" के रूप में जाना जाता है। समय से पहले एक नमूना मतपत्र की समीक्षा करना निर्णय लेना आसान बना सकता है।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निचला लाइन

segments.src: Campaign coverage naturally focuses on candidates, but the ballot is often much longer than the headlines suggest.
segments.tr: अभियान कवरेज स्वाभाविक रूप से उम्मीदवारों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है, लेकिन मतपत्र अक्सर सुर्खियों से कहीं अधिक लंबा होता है।

segments.src: Taking time to learn about the questions that appear on your own ballot is one of the most direct ways to have a say in the rules, taxes and policies that affect your state.
segments.tr: अपने मतपत्र पर दिखाई देने वाले प्रश्नों के बारे में जानने के लिए समय निकालना नियमों, करों और नीतियों में अपनी बात कहने के सबसे प्रत्यक्ष तरीकों में से एक है जो आपके राज्य को प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: Check your local election office for a sample ballot and voter guide, and confirm your registration status and voting options well before Election Day.
segments.tr: नमूना मतपत्र और मतदाता मार्गदर्शिका के लिए अपने स्थानीय चुनाव कार्यालय की जाँच करें, और चुनाव के दिन से बहुत पहले अपनी पंजीकरण स्थिति और मतदान विकल्पों की पुष्टि करें।

es.title: Más allá de los candidatos: cómo las medidas electorales estatales dan forma a las políticas en noviembre

segments.src: When Americans head to the polls in November, the biggest names on the ticket will be candidates for the Senate, the House and governor's offices.
segments.tr: Cuando los estadounidenses acudan a las urnas en noviembre, los nombres más importantes en la boleta serán los candidatos al Senado, a la Cámara de Representantes y a las gobernaciones.

segments.src: But look further down the ballot and many voters will find something different: questions that ask them to decide a policy directly.
segments.tr: Pero si miran más abajo en la boleta, muchos votantes encontrarán algo diferente: preguntas que les piden decidir una política directamente.

segments.src: Ballot measures can raise the minimum wage, change how taxes are collected, rewrite election rules or amend a state constitution, and the outcomes often have a more immediate effect on daily life than a single seat in a legislature.
segments.tr: Las medidas electorales pueden aumentar el salario mínimo, cambiar la forma en que se recaudan los impuestos, reescribir las reglas electorales o enmendar la constitución de un estado, y los resultados a menudo tienen un efecto más inmediato en la vida diaria que un solo escaño en una legislatura.

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## ¿Qué es una medida electoral?

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: Una medida electoral es una pregunta planteada directamente a los votantes en lugar de a los funcionarios electos.

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: Dependiendo del estado, puede llamarse proposición, pregunta, enmienda o referéndum.

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: La redacción difiere, pero la idea es la misma: un voto de "sí" o "no" puede cambiar una ley o la constitución de un estado.

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: Las medidas electorales generalmente se dividen en algunas categorías:

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **Estatutos iniciados:** Los ciudadanos proponen una nueva ley, reúnen suficientes firmas para calificar, y los votantes la aprueban o rechazan.

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **Enmiendas constitucionales iniciadas:** Los ciudadanos proponen un cambio a la constitución estatal a través del mismo proceso de firmas, en los estados que lo permiten.

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **Referencias legislativas:** La legislatura coloca una propuesta de ley o enmienda constitucional en la boleta. En la mayoría de los estados, las enmiendas constitucionales deben pasar por los votantes antes de entrar en vigor.

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **Referéndums de veto:** Los ciudadanos recolectan firmas para preguntar a los votantes si una ley que la legislatura ya ha aprobado debe permanecer vigente.

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## Cómo llegan las medidas a la boleta

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: Las reglas varían ampliamente de un estado a otro.

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: Aproximadamente la mitad de los estados permiten alguna forma de medida iniciada por los ciudadanos, mientras que todos los estados utilizan referencias legislativas de alguna forma.

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: Donde se permiten las iniciativas ciudadanas, los partidarios generalmente deben:

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **Presentar una petición** ante una oficina estatal, a menudo incluyendo el texto exacto de la propuesta.

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: 2. **Recibir un título y resumen oficial**, que es el lenguaje que los votantes verán eventualmente. Esta redacción es a veces objeto de disputas legales.

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **Recopilar firmas** de votantes registrados. El número requerido a menudo está vinculado a la participación en una elección anterior, y algunos estados también requieren que las firmas se distribuyan entre regiones.

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **Pasar la verificación**, en la cual los funcionarios electorales revisan las firmas y la medida puede enfrentar una revisión judicial antes de ser certificada.

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: Debido a este proceso, las campañas a menudo comienzan más de un año antes del día de las elecciones.

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: Las campañas de recolección de firmas pueden ser costosas, y los desafíos legales sobre la redacción, el tema o la validez de las firmas pueden decidir si una medida aparece en la boleta en absoluto.

segments.src: ## The Issues Voters Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## Los temas que los votantes están sopesando

segments.src: Ballot measures tend to cluster around a handful of recurring subjects.
segments.tr: Las medidas electorales tienden a agruparse en torno a un puñado de temas recurrentes.

segments.src: Several categories are common in many election cycles.
segments.tr: Varias categorías son comunes en muchos ciclos electorales.

segments.src: ### Wages and Workplace Rules
segments.tr: ### Salarios y reglas laborales

segments.src: Minimum wage proposals have appeared on ballots in many states, along with questions about paid sick leave and tipped-worker pay.
segments.tr: Las propuestas de salario mínimo han aparecido en las boletas en muchos estados, junto con preguntas sobre la licencia por enfermedad pagada y el pago a trabajadores que reciben propinas.

segments.src: Because wage rules affect household budgets and business costs at the same time, these measures draw attention from both employees and employers.
segments.tr: Debido a que las reglas salariales afectan los presupuestos familiares y los costos comerciales al mismo tiempo, estas medidas atraen la atención tanto de empleados como de empleadores.

segments.src: ### Taxes and Budgets
segments.tr: ### Impuestos y presupuestos

segments.src: Voters are frequently asked to approve or reject changes to property, income or sales taxes, to set limits on government spending, or to authorize bonds for schools, roads and other public projects.
segments.tr: A menudo se pide a los votantes que aprueben o rechacen cambios en los impuestos a la propiedad, sobre la renta o sobre las ventas, que establezcan límites al gasto público o que autoricen bonos para escuelas, carreteras y otros proyectos públicos.

segments.src: These questions often come with detailed fiscal analyses prepared by nonpartisan state agencies.
segments.tr: Estas preguntas a menudo vienen con análisis fiscales detallados preparados por agencias estatales no partidistas.

segments.src: ### Election Rules
segments.tr: ### Reglas electorales

segments.src: Some of the most closely watched measures concern the process of voting itself.
segments.tr: Algunas de las medidas más observadas de cerca se refieren al proceso de votación en sí.

segments.src: Topics have included voter identification requirements, ranked-choice voting, open primaries, redistricting commissions and campaign finance rules.
segments.tr: Los temas han incluido requisitos de identificación de votantes, votación por orden de preferencia, primarias abiertas, comisiones de redistribución de distritos y reglas de financiamiento de campañas.

segments.src: Since these measures set the framework for future elections, they can shape which candidates compete and how votes are counted.
segments.tr: Dado que estas medidas establecen el marco para futuras elecciones, pueden dar forma a qué candidatos compiten y cómo se cuentan los votos.

segments.src: ### Other Policy Areas
segments.tr: ### Otras áreas de política

segments.src: Housing, health care, public safety, education funding and environmental policy also regularly appear.
segments.tr: La vivienda, la atención médica, la seguridad pública, el financiamiento de la educación y la política ambiental también aparecen regularmente.

segments.src: Individual states may also present highly local questions that never become national news.
segments.tr: Los estados individuales también pueden presentar preguntas altamente locales que nunca se convierten en noticias nacionales.

segments.src: ## Why These Measures Can Matter as Much as Any Candidate
segments.tr: ## Por qué estas medidas pueden importar tanto como cualquier candidato

segments.src: A single legislator is one vote among many.
segments.tr: Un solo legislador es un voto entre muchos.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, can become law or a constitutional provision on its own once voters approve it.
segments.tr: Una medida electoral, por el contrario, puede convertirse en ley o en una disposición constitucional por sí misma una vez que los votantes la aprueban.

segments.src: That has several consequences:
segments.tr: Eso tiene varias consecuencias:

segments.src: - **Direct and durable change.** A constitutional amendment can be difficult to undo, since reversing it often requires another statewide vote.
segments.tr: - **Cambio directo y duradero.** Una enmienda constitucional puede ser difícil de deshacer, ya que revertirla a menudo requiere otra votación estatal.

segments.src: - **Policy outside the legislature.** Voters can act on topics that lawmakers have been unwilling or unable to address, or can reject proposals the legislature has passed.
segments.tr: - **Política fuera de la legislatura.** Los votantes pueden actuar sobre temas que los legisladores no han querido o no han podido abordar, o pueden rechazar propuestas que la legislatura ha aprobado.

segments.src: - **Influence on turnout.** High-profile measures can motivate people to vote who might otherwise skip a midterm election.
segments.tr: - **Influencia en la participación.** Las medidas de alto perfil pueden motivar a las personas a votar que de otro modo podrían saltarse una elección de mitad de período.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Successful measures in one state are often studied and copied by advocates in others.
segments.tr: - **Efectos dominó.** Las medidas exitosas en un estado a menudo son estudiadas y copiadas por defensores en otros.

segments.src: ## How to Prepare as a Voter
segments.tr: ## Cómo prepararse como votante

segments.src: Ballot measures can be dense, and the wording is not always easy to follow.
segments.tr: Las medidas electorales pueden ser densas, y la redacción no siempre es fácil de seguir.

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: Algunos hábitos ayudan:

segments.src: - **Read the full text and the official summary,** not just the title. Official voter guides, usually published by the secretary of state or election office, include the exact language and arguments for and against.
segments.tr: - **Lea el texto completo y el resumen oficial,** no solo el título. Las guías oficiales para votantes, generalmente publicadas por el secretario de estado u oficina electoral, incluyen el lenguaje exacto y los argumentos a favor y en contra.

segments.src: - **Check the fiscal analysis.** Many states publish independent estimates of what a measure would cost or save.
segments.tr: - **Revise el análisis fiscal.** Muchos estados publican estimaciones independientes de lo que costaría o ahorraría una medida.

segments.src: - **Understand what "yes" and "no" mean.** On some measures, a "yes" vote keeps current law while a "no" vote changes it, or the reverse. The wording can be counterintuitive.
segments.tr: - **Entienda lo que significan "sí" y "no".** En algunas medidas, un voto de "sí" mantiene la ley actual mientras que un voto de "no" la cambia, o viceversa. La redacción puede ser contraintuitiva.

segments.src: - **Look at who is funding each side.** State campaign finance databases list major donors for and against a measure.
segments.tr: - **Mire quién está financiando cada lado.** Las bases de datos estatales de financiamiento de campañas enumeran a los principales donantes a favor y en contra de una medida.

segments.src: - **Use trusted, nonpartisan sources.** Local newsrooms, nonpartisan research organizations and official state publications can help separate the facts from campaign advertising.
segments.tr: - **Utilice fuentes confiables y no partidistas.** Las salas de redacción locales, las organizaciones de investigación no partidistas y las publicaciones estatales oficiales pueden ayudar a separar los hechos de la publicidad de campaña.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote the whole ballot.** Some voters leave ballot questions blank, a practice known as "ballot roll-off." Reviewing a sample ballot ahead of time can make it easier to decide.
segments.tr: - **Haga un plan para votar toda la boleta.** Algunos votantes dejan las preguntas de la boleta en blanco, una práctica conocida como "ballot roll-off". Revisar una boleta de muestra con anticipación puede facilitar la decisión.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: Campaign coverage naturally focuses on candidates, but the ballot is often much longer than the headlines suggest.
segments.tr: La cobertura de la campaña se centra naturalmente en los candidatos, pero la boleta suele ser mucho más larga de lo que sugieren los titulares.

segments.src: Taking time to learn about the questions that appear on your own ballot is one of the most direct ways to have a say in the rules, taxes and policies that affect your state.
segments.tr: Tomarse el tiempo para aprender sobre las preguntas que aparecen en su propia boleta es una de las formas más directas de tener voz en las reglas, impuestos y políticas que afectan a su estado.

segments.src: Check your local election office for a sample ballot and voter guide, and confirm your registration status and voting options well before Election Day.
segments.tr: Consulte a su oficina electoral local para obtener una boleta de muestra y una guía para el votante, y confirme su estado de registro y sus opciones de votación mucho antes del día de las elecciones.

ar.title: ما بعد المرشحين: كيف تشكل تدابير الاقتراع الحكومية السياسة في شهر نوفمبر

segments.src: When Americans head to the polls in November, the biggest names on the ticket will be candidates for the Senate, the House and governor's offices.
segments.tr: عندما يتوجه الأمريكيون إلى صناديق الاقتراع في شهر نوفمبر، ستكون الأسماء الأبرز على بطاقة الاقتراع هي مرشحو مجلس الشيوخ ومجلس النواب ومكاتب الحكام.

segments.src: But look further down the ballot and many voters will find something different: questions that ask them to decide a policy directly.
segments.tr: ولكن بالنظر إلى أسفل بطاقة الاقتراع، سيجد العديد من الناخبين شيئاً مختلفاً: أسئلة تطلب منهم اتخاذ قرار بشأن سياسة ما بشكل مباشر.

segments.src: Ballot measures can raise the minimum wage, change how taxes are collected, rewrite election rules or amend a state constitution, and the outcomes often have a more immediate effect on daily life than a single seat in a legislature.
segments.tr: يمكن لتدابير الاقتراع أن ترفع الحد الأدنى للأجور، أو تغیر طريقة جباية الضرائب، أو تعيد كتابة قواعد الانتخابات أو تعدل دستور الولاية، وغالباً ما يكون للنتائج تأثير أكثر مباشرة على الحياة اليومية مقارنة بمقعد واحد في الهيئة التشريعية.

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## ما هو تدبير الاقتراع؟

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: تدبير الاقتراع هو سؤال يُطرح مباشرة على الناخبين وليس على المسؤولين المنتخبين.

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: اعتماداً على الولاية، قد يسمى مقترحاً، أو سؤالاً، أو تعديلاً، أو استفتاءً.

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: الصياغة تختلف، لكن الفكرة واحدة: تصويت بـ "نعم" أو "لا" يمكن أن يغير قانوناً أو دستور ولاية.

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: تنقسم تدابير الاقتراع عموماً إلى عدة فئات:

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **القوانين المبادرة من المواطنين:** يقترح المواطنون قانوناً جديداً، ويجمعون ما يكفي من التوقيعات للتأهل، ويقوم الناخبون بالموافقة عليه أو رفضه.

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **التعديلات الدستورية المبادرة من المواطنين:** يقترح المواطنون تغييراً على دستور الولاية من خلال نفس عملية جمع التوقيعات، في الولاية التي تسمح بذلك.

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **الإحالات التشريعية:** تضع الهيئة التشريعية قانوناً مقترحاً أو تعديلاً دستورياً على بطاقة الاقتراع. في معظم الولايات، يجب أن تذهب التعديلات الدستورية إلى الناخبين قبل أن تدخل حيز التنفيذ.

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **استفتاءات حق النقض:** يجمع المواطنون التوقيعات لسؤال الناخبين عما إذا كان القانون الذي أقرته الهيئة التشريعية بالفعل يجب أن يظل ساري المفعول.

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## كيف تصل التدابير إلى بطاقة الاقتراع

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: تختلف القواعد بشكل كبير من ولاية إلى أخرى.

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: نحو نصف الولايات تسمح بشكل ما من التدابير التي يبادر بها المواطنون، بينما تستخدم كل ولاية الإحالات التشريعية بشكل ما.

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: حيثما يُسمح بمبادرات المواطنين، عادة ما يُطلب من المؤيدين:

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **تقديم عريضة** إلى مكتب الولاية، وغالباً ما تتضمن النص الدقيق للمقترح.

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: 2. **تلقي عنوان رسمي وملخص**، وهو اللغة التي سيراها الناخبون في النهاية. هذه الصياغة تكون أحياناً موضوع نزاعات قانونية.

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **جمع التوقيعات** من الناخبين المسجلين. غالباً ما يرتبط العدد المطلوب بنسبة المشاركة في انتخابات سابقة، وتطلب بعض الولايات أيضاً توزيع التوقيعات عبر المناطق.

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **اجتياز التحقق**، حيث يقوم مسؤولو الانتخابات بفحص التوقيعات وقد يواجه التدبير مراجعة قضائية قبل اعتماده.

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: بسبب هذه العملية، غالباً ما تبدأ الحملات قبل أكثر من عام من يوم الانتخابات.

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: حملات جمع التوقيعات يمكن أن تكون مكلفة، والتحديات القانونية حول الصياغة أو موضوع النقاش أو صحة التوقيعات يمكن أن تقرر ما إذا كان التدبير سيظهر على بطاقة الاقتراع أم لا.

segments.src: ## The Issues Voters Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## القضايا التي يزنها الناخبون

segments.src: Ballot measures tend to cluster around a handful of recurring subjects.
segments.tr: تميل تدابير الاقتراع إلى التجمع حول عدد قليل من المواضيع المتكررة.

segments.src: Several categories are common in many election cycles.
segments.tr: العديد من الفئات شائعة في العديد من دورات الانتخابات.

segments.src: ### Wages and Workplace Rules
segments.tr: ### الأجور وقواعد مكان العمل

segments.src: Minimum wage proposals have appeared on ballots in many states, along with questions about paid sick leave and tipped-worker pay.
segments.tr: ظهرت مقترحات الحد الأدنى للأجور على بطاقات الاقتراع في العديد من الولايات، إلى جانب أسئلة حول إجازة المرض المدفوعة وأجور العمال الذين يتلقون البقشيش.

segments.src: Because wage rules affect household budgets and business costs at the same time, these measures draw attention from both employees and employers.
segments.tr: ونظراً لأن قواعد الأجور تؤثر على ميزانيات الأسر وتكاليف الشركات في نفس الوقت، فإن هذه التدابير تجذب انتباه كل من الموظفين وأصحاب العمل.

segments.src: ### Taxes and Budgets
segments.tr: ### الضرائب والميزانيات

segments.src: Voters are frequently asked to approve or reject changes to property, income or sales taxes, to set limits on government spending, or to authorize bonds for schools, roads and other public projects.
segments.tr: يُطلب من الناخبين بشكل متكرر الموافقة على أو رفض التغييرات على ضرائب الممتلكات أو الدخل أو المبيعات، أو وضع قيود على الإنفاق الحكومي، أو تفويض السندات للمدارس والطرق والمشاريع العامة الأخرى.

segments.src: These questions often come with detailed fiscal analyses prepared by nonpartisan state agencies.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تأتي هذه الأسئلة مصحوبة بتحليلات مالية مفصلة أعدتها وكالات ولاية غير حزبية.

segments.src: ### Election Rules
segments.tr: ### قواعد الانتخابات

segments.src: Some of the most closely watched measures concern the process of voting itself.
segments.tr: بعض التدابير الأكثر مراقبة عن كثب تتعلق بعملية التصويت نفسها.

segments.src: Topics have included voter identification requirements, ranked-choice voting, open primaries, redistricting commissions and campaign finance rules.
segments.tr: شملت الموضوعات متطلبات تحديد هوية الناخب، والتصويت التفضيلي، والانتخابات التمهيدية المفتوحة، ولجان إعادة تقسيم الدوائر، وقواعد تمويل الحملات الانتخابية.

segments.src: Since these measures set the framework for future elections, they can shape which candidates compete and how votes are counted.
segments.tr: بما أن هذه التدابير تضع الإطار للانتخابات المستقبلية، فإنها يمكن أن تشكل المرشحين الذين يتنافسون وكيفية فرز الأصوات.

segments.src: ### Other Policy Areas
segments.tr: ### مجالات سياسة أخرى

segments.src: Housing, health care, public safety, education funding and environmental policy also regularly appear.
segments.tr: الإسكان، والرعاية الصحية، والسلامة العامة، وتمويل التعليم، والسياسة البيئية تظهر بانتظام أيضاً.

segments.src: Individual states may also present highly local questions that never become national news.
segments.tr: قد تقدم الولايات الفردية أيضاً أسئلة محليّة للغاية لا تصبح أبداً أخباراً وطنية.

segments.src: ## Why These Measures Can Matter as Much as Any Candidate
segments.tr: ## لماذا يمكن أن تكون هذه التدابير مهمة بقدر أي مرشح

segments.src: A single legislator is one vote among many.
segments.tr: المشرع الواحد هو صوت واحد بين أصوات عديدة.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, can become law or a constitutional provision on its own once voters approve it.
segments.tr: في المقابل، يمكن لتدبير الاقتراع أن يصبح قانوناً أو بنداً دستورياً بمفرده بمجرد أن يوافقه الناخبون.

segments.src: That has several consequences:
segments.tr: هذا له عدة نتائج:

segments.src: - **Direct and durable change.** A constitutional amendment can be difficult to undo, since reversing it often requires another statewide vote.
segments.tr: - **تغيير مباشر ودائم.** يمكن أن يكون التعديل الدستوري صعب التراجع عنه، نظراً لأن إلغاءه يتطلب غالباً تصويتاً آخر على مستوى الولاية.

segments.src: - **Policy outside the legislature.** Voters can act on topics that lawmakers have been unwilling or unable to address, or can reject proposals the legislature has passed.
segments.tr: - **السياسة خارج الهيئة التشريعية.** يمكن للناخبين التصرف بشأن موضوعات لم تكن الهيئة التشريعية راغبة أو قادرة على معالجتها، أو يمكنهم رفض المقترحات التي أقرتها الهيئة التشريعية.

segments.src: - **Influence on turnout.** High-profile measures can motivate people to vote who might otherwise skip a midterm election.
segments.tr: - **التأثير على نسبة المشاركة.** يمكن للتدابير البارزة أن تحفز الأشخاص على التصويت الذين قد يتخطون انتخابات التجديد النصفي لولا ذلك.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Successful measures in one state are often studied and copied by advocates in others.
segments.tr: - **تأثيرات مضاعفة.** التدابير الناجحة في ولاية ما غالباً ما يدرسها ويقلدها المدافعون في ولايات أخرى.

segments.src: ## How to Prepare as a Voter
segments.tr: ## كيف تستعد لناخب

segments.src: Ballot measures can be dense, and the wording is not always easy to follow.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تكون تدابير الاقتراع معقدة، والصياغة ليست سهلة المتابعة دائماً.

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: تساعد بعض العادات:

segments.src: - **Read the full text and the official summary,** not just the title. Official voter guides, usually published by the secretary of state or election office, include the exact language and arguments for and against.
segments.tr: - **قراءة النص الكامل والملخص الرسمي،** وليس فقط العنوان. أدلة الناخبين الرسمية، التي تنشرها عادة سكرتارية الولاية أو مكتب الانتخابات، تتضمن النص الدقيق والحجج المؤيدة والمعارضة.

segments.src: - **Check the fiscal analysis.** Many states publish independent estimates of what a measure would cost or save.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من التحليل المالي.** تنشر العديد من الولايات تقديرات مستقلة لما سيكلفه التدبير أو يوفره.

segments.src: - **Understand what "yes" and "no" mean.** On some measures, a "yes" vote keeps current law while a "no" vote changes it, or the reverse. The wording can be counterintuitive.
segments.tr: - **فهم ما تعنيه "نعم" و "لا".** في بعض التدابير، التصويت بـ "نعم" يبقي القانون الحالي بينما التصويت بـ "لا" يغيره، أو العكس. يمكن أن تكون الصياغة غير بديهية.

segments.src: - **Look at who is funding each side.** State campaign finance databases list major donors for and against a measure.
segments.tr: - **انظر إلى من يمول كل جانب.** قواعد بيانات تمويل الحملات الانتخابية للولاية تذكر كبار المانحين المؤيدين والمعارضين للتدبير.

segments.src: - **Use trusted, nonpartisan sources.** Local newsrooms, nonpartisan research organizations and official state publications can help separate the facts from campaign advertising.
segments.tr: - **استخدم مصادر موثوقة وغير حزبية.** غرف الأخبار المحلية، ومنظمات الأبحاث غير الحزبية، ومنشورات الولاية الرسمية يمكن أن تساعد في فصل الحقائق عن إعلانات الحملات الانتخابية.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote the whole ballot.** Some voters leave ballot questions blank, a practice known as "ballot roll-off." Reviewing a sample ballot ahead of time can make it easier to decide.
segments.tr: - **ضع خطة للتصويت على بطاقة الاقتراع كاملة.** يترك بعض الناخبين أسئلة بطاقة الاقتراع فارغة، وهي ممارسة تُعرف باسم "التراجع عن بطاقة الاقتراع". مراجعة نموذج بطاقة اقتراع مسبقاً يمكن أن تجعل اتخاذ القرار أسهل.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Campaign coverage naturally focuses on candidates, but the ballot is often much longer than the headlines suggest.
segments.tr: تركز تغطية الحملات الانتخابية بطبيعة الحال على المرشحين، لكن بطاقة الاقتراع غالباً ما تكون أطول بكثير مما تشير إليه عناوين الأخبار.

segments.src: Taking time to learn about the questions that appear on your own ballot is one of the most direct ways to have a say in the rules, taxes and policies that affect your state.
segments.tr: أخذ الوقت للتعرف على الأسئلة التي تظهر على بطاقة اقتراعك الخاصة هو أحد أكثر الطرق مباشرة ليكون لك رأي في القواعد والضرائب والسياسات التي تؤثر على ولايتك.

segments.src: Check your local election office for a sample ballot and voter guide, and confirm your registration status and voting options well before Election Day.
segments.tr: تحقق من مكتب الانتخابات المحلي الخاص بك للحصول على نموذج بطاقة اقتراع ودليل الناخب، وتأكد من حالة تسجيلك وخيارات التصويت قبل يوم الانتخابات بوقت كافٍ.

fr.title: Au-delà des candidats : comment les référendums d'initiative populaire façonnent la politique en novembre

segments.src: When Americans head to the polls in November, the biggest names on the ticket will be candidates for the Senate, the House and governor's offices.
segments.tr: Lorsque les Américains se rendront aux urnes en novembre, les têtes d'affiche seront les candidats au Sénat, à la Chambre des représentants et aux postes de gouverneur.

segments.src: But look further down the ballot and many voters will find something different: questions that ask them to decide a policy directly.
segments.tr: Mais en regardant plus bas sur le bulletin de vote, de nombreux électeurs trouveront autre chose : des questions qui leur demandent de décider directement d'une politique.

segments.src: Ballot measures can raise the minimum wage, change how taxes are collected, rewrite election rules or amend a state constitution, and the outcomes often have a more immediate effect on daily life than a single seat in a legislature.
segments.tr: Les référendums d'initiative populaire peuvent augmenter le salaire minimum, modifier la perception des impôts, réécrire les règles électorales ou amender la constitution d'un État, et les résultats ont souvent un effet plus immédiat sur la vie quotidienne qu'un seul siège dans une législature.

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## Qu'est-ce qu'un référendum d'initiative populaire ?

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: Un référendum d'initiative populaire est une question posée directement aux électeurs plutôt qu'aux élus.

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: Selon l'État, il peut être appelé proposition, question, amendement ou référendum.

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: La formulation diffère, mais l'idée est la même : un vote "oui" ou "non" peut modifier une loi ou la constitution d'un État.

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: Les référendums d'initiative populaire se divisent généralement en quelques catégories :

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **Lois d'initiative citoyenne :** Les citoyens proposent une nouvelle loi, recueillent suffisamment de signatures pour qu'elle soit validée, et les électeurs l'approuvent ou la rejettent.

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **Amendements constitutionnels d'initiative citoyenne :** Les citoyens proposent une modification de la constitution de l'État par le même processus de signature, dans les États qui le permettent.

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **Saisines législatives :** La législature soumet un projet de loi ou un amendement constitutionnel au vote. Dans la plupart des États, les amendements constitutionnels doivent être soumis aux électeurs avant d'entrer en vigueur.

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **Référendums abrogatifs :** Les citoyens recueillent des signatures pour demander aux électeurs si une loi déjà votée par la législature doit rester en vigueur.

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## Comment les questions arrivent sur le bulletin de vote

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: Les règles varient considérablement d'un État à l'autre.

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: Environ la moitié des États autorisent une forme de mesure d'initiative citoyenne, tandis que tous les États utilisent des saisines législatives sous une forme ou une autre.

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: Là où les initiatives citoyennes sont autorisées, les partisans doivent généralement :

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **Déposer une pétition** auprès d'un bureau de l'État, en incluant souvent le texte exact de la proposition.

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: 2. **Recevoir un titre officiel et un résumé**, qui est le libellé que les électeurs verront finalement. Cette formulation fait parfois l'objet de litiges juridiques.

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **Recueillir des signatures** auprès d'électeurs inscrits. Le nombre requis est souvent lié à la participation à une élection précédente, et certains États exigent également que les signatures soient réparties entre les régions.

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **Passer la vérification**, au cours de laquelle les agents électoraux vérifient les signatures et la mesure peut faire l'objet d'un examen judiciaire avant d'être certifiée.

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: En raison de ce processus, les campagnes commencent souvent plus d'un an avant le jour de l'élection.

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: Les campagnes de signatures peuvent être coûteuses, et les contestations juridiques concernant la formulation, le sujet ou la valadité des signatures peuvent décider si une question apparaît ou non sur le bulletin de vote.

segments.src: ## The Issues Voters Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## Les sujets qui préoccupent les électeurs

segments.src: Ballot measures tend to cluster around a handful of recurring subjects.
segments.tr: Les référendums ont tendance à se regrouper autour d'une poignée de sujets récurrents.

segments.src: Several categories are common in many election cycles.
segments.tr: Plusieurs catégories sont courantes dans de nombreux cycles électoraux.

segments.src: ### Wages and Workplace Rules
segments.tr: ### Salaires et règles sur le lieu de travail

segments.src: Minimum wage proposals have appeared on ballots in many states, along with questions about paid sick leave and tipped-worker pay.
segments.tr: Des propositions sur le salaire minimum sont apparues sur les bulletins de vote dans de nombreux États, ainsi que des questions sur le congé de maladie payé et la rémunération des travailleurs au pourboire.

segments.src: Because wage rules affect household budgets and business costs at the same time, these measures draw attention from both employees and employers.
segments.tr: Étant donné que les règles salariales affectent à la fois le budget des ménages et les coûts des entreprises, ces mesures attirent l'attention des employés et des employeurs.

segments.src: ### Taxes and Budgets
segments.tr: ### Impôts et budgets

segments.src: Voters are frequently asked to approve or reject changes to property, income or sales taxes, to set limits on government spending, or to authorize bonds for schools, roads and other public projects.
segments.tr: Il est fréquemment demandé aux électeurs d'approuver ou de rejeter des modifications des impôts fonciers, sur le revenu ou sur les ventes, de fixer des limites aux dépenses publiques ou d'autoriser des emprunts pour les écoles, les routes et d'autres projets publics.

segments.src: These questions often come with detailed fiscal analyses prepared by nonpartisan state agencies.
segments.tr: Ces questions s'accompagnent souvent d'analyses fiscales détaillées préparées par des agences étatiques non partisanes.

segments.src: ### Election Rules
segments.tr: ### Règles électorales

segments.src: Some of the most closely watched measures concern the process of voting itself.
segments.tr: Certaines des mesures les plus suivies concernent le processus de vote lui-même.

segments.src: Topics have included voter identification requirements, ranked-choice voting, open primaries, redistricting commissions and campaign finance rules.
segments.tr: Les sujets ont inclus les exigences d'identification des électeurs, le vote préférentiel, les primaires ouvertes, les commissions de redécoupage électoral et les règles de financement des campagnes.

segments.src: Since these measures set the framework for future elections, they can shape which candidates compete and how votes are counted.
segments.tr: Puisque ces mesures fixent le cadre des futures élections, elles peuvent déterminer quels candidats s'affrontent et comment les votes sont comptés.

segments.src: ### Other Policy Areas
segments.tr: ### Autres domaines politiques

segments.src: Housing, health care, public safety, education funding and environmental policy also regularly appear.
segments.tr: Le logement, les soins de santé, la sécurité publique, le financement de l'éducation et la politique environnementale font également régulièrement leur apparition.

segments.src: Individual states may also present highly local questions that never become national news.
segments.tr: Les différents États peuvent également présenter des questions très locales qui ne font jamais l'objet de nouvelles nationales.

segments.src: ## Why These Measures Can Matter as Much as Any Candidate
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ces mesures peuvent compter autant que n'importe quel candidat

segments.src: A single legislator is one vote among many.
segments.tr: Un simple législateur n'est qu'une voix parmi tant d'autres.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, can become law or a constitutional provision on its own once voters approve it.
segments.tr: Un référendum d'initiative populaire, en revanche, peut devenir une loi ou une disposition constitutionnelle de plein droit une fois approuvé par les électeurs.

segments.src: That has several consequences:
segments.tr: Cela a plusieurs conséquences :

segments.src: - **Direct and durable change.** A constitutional amendment can be difficult to undo, since reversing it often requires another statewide vote.
segments.tr: - **Un changement direct et durable.** Un amendement constitutionnel peut être difficile à annuler, car son inversion nécessite souvent un autre vote à l'échelle de l'État.

segments.src: - **Policy outside the legislature.** Voters can act on topics that lawmakers have been unwilling or unable to address, or can reject proposals the legislature has passed.
segments.tr: - **Une politique en dehors de la législature.** Les électeurs peuvent agir sur des sujets que les législateurs n'ont pas voulu ou pu aborder, ou rejeter des propositions adoptées par la législature.

segments.src: - **Influence on turnout.** High-profile measures can motivate people to vote who might otherwise skip a midterm election.
segments.tr: - **Une influence sur la participation.** Les mesures très médiatisées peuvent motiver des personnes à voter qui autrement sauteraient une élection de mi-mandat.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Successful measures in one state are often studied and copied by advocates in others.
segments.tr: - **Des effets d'entraînement.** Les mesures couronnées de succès dans un État sont souvent étudiées et copiées par des militants dans d'autres.

segments.src: ## How to Prepare as a Voter
segments.tr: ## Comment se préparer en tant qu'électeur

segments.src: Ballot measures can be dense, and the wording is not always easy to follow.
segments.tr: Les référendums peuvent être denses, et la formulation n'est pas toujours facile à suivre.

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: Quelques habitudes sont utiles :

segments.src: - **Read the full text and the official summary,** not just the title. Official voter guides, usually published by the secretary of state or election office, include the exact language and arguments for and against.
segments.tr: - **Lire le texte intégral et le résumé officiel,** et pas seulement le titre. Les guides officiels des électeurs, généralement publiés par le secrétaire d'État ou le bureau électoral, incluent le libellé exact ainsi que les arguments pour et contre.

segments.src: - **Check the fiscal analysis.** Many states publish independent estimates of what a measure would cost or save.
segments.tr: - **Vérifier l'analyse fiscale.** De nombreux États publient des estimations indépendantes de ce qu'une mesure coûterait ou permettrait d'économiser.
