segments.src: - **Understand what "yes" and "no" mean.** On some measures, a "yes" vote keeps current law while a "no" vote changes it, or the reverse. The wording can be counterintuitive.
segments.tr: - **Comprendre ce que signifient "oui" et "non".** Sur certaines questions, un vote "oui" maintient la loi actuelle tandis qu'un vote "non" la modifie, ou inversement. La formulation peut être contre-intuitive.

segments.src: - **Look at who is funding each side.** State campaign finance databases list major donors for and against a measure.
segments.tr: - **Regarder qui finance chaque camp.** Les bases de données sur le financement des campagnes électorales de l'État répertorient les principaux donateurs pour et contre une mesure.

segments.src: - **Use trusted, nonpartisan sources.** Local newsrooms, nonpartisan research organizations and official state publications can help separate the facts from campaign advertising.
segments.tr: - **Utiliser des sources fiables et non partisanes.** Les rédactions locales, les organisations de recherche non partisanes et les publications officielles de l'État peuvent aider à séparer les faits de la publicité de campagne.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote the whole ballot.** Some voters leave ballot questions blank, a practice known as "ballot roll-off." Reviewing a sample ballot ahead of time can make it easier to decide.
segments.tr: - **Prévoir de voter sur l'ensemble du bulletin.** Certains électeurs laissent des questions en blanc, une pratique connue sous le nom de "ballot roll-off". Examiner un spécimen de bulletin de vote à l'avance peut faciliter la décision.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: Campaign coverage naturally focuses on candidates, but the ballot is often much longer than the headlines suggest.
segments.tr: La couverture des campagnes se concentre naturellement sur les candidats, mais le bulletin de vote est souvent bien plus long que ne le suggèrent les grands titres.

segments.src: Taking time to learn about the questions that appear on your own ballot is one of the most direct ways to have a say in the rules, taxes and policies that affect your state.
segments.tr: Prendre le temps de se renseigner sur les questions qui figurent sur votre propre bulletin de vote est l'un des moyens les plus directs d'avoir son mot à dire sur les règles, les impôts et les politiques qui affectent votre État.

segments.src: Check your local election office for a sample ballot and voter guide, and confirm your registration status and voting options well before Election Day.
segments.tr: Consultez le bureau électoral de votre localité pour obtenir un spécimen de bulletin de vote et un guide de l'électeur, et confirmez votre statut d'inscription ainsi que vos options de vote bien avant le jour du scrutin.

pt.title: Além dos Candidatos: Como as Propostas de Eleição Estadual Moldam a Política em Novembro

segments.src: When Americans head to the polls in November, the biggest names on the ticket will be candidates for the Senate, the House and governor's offices.
segments.tr: Quando os americanos vão às urnas em novembro, os nomes mais proeminentes na cédula serão os candidatos ao Senado, à Câmara e aos cargos de governador.

segments.src: But look further down the ballot and many voters will find something different: questions that ask them to decide a policy directly.
segments.tr: Mas, olhando mais abaixo na cédula, muitos eleitores encontrarão algo diferente: perguntas que pedem que decidam sobre uma política diretamente.

segments.src: Ballot measures can raise the minimum wage, change how taxes are collected, rewrite election rules or amend a state constitution, and the outcomes often have a more immediate effect on daily life than a single seat in a legislature.
segments.tr: As propostas de votação podem aumentar o salário mínimo, mudar a forma como os impostos são cobrados, reescrever as regras eleitorais ou alterar a constituição de um estado, e os resultados geralmente têm um efeito mais imediato na vida diária do que uma única cadeira em uma legislatura.

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## O que é uma Proposta de Votação?

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: Uma proposta de votação é uma questão apresentada diretamente aos eleitores, em vez de aos funcionários eleitos.

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: Dependendo do estado, ela pode ser chamada de proposição, questão, emenda ou referendo.

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: A redação difere, mas a ideia é a mesma: um voto "sim" ou "não" pode alterar uma lei ou a constituição de um estado.

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: As propostas de votação geralmente se enquadram em algumas categorias:

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **Estatutos iniciados por cidadãos:** Os cidadãos propõem uma nova lei, reúnem assinaturas suficientes para qualificá-la e os eleitores a aprovam ou rejeitam.

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **Emendas constitucionais iniciadas por cidadãos:** Os cidadãos propõem uma alteração à constituição estadual por meio do mesmo processo de assinatura, nos estados que o permitem.

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **Encaminhamentos legislativos:** A legislatura coloca uma proposta de lei ou emenda constitucional na cédula. Na maioria dos estados, as emendas constitucionais devem passar pelos eleitores antes de entrarem em vigor.

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **Referendos de veto:** Os cidadãos coletam assinaturas para perguntar aos eleitores se uma lei que a legislatura já aprovou deve continuar em vigor.

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## Como as Propostas chegam à Cédula

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: As regras variam muito de estado para estado.

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: Aproximadamente metade dos estados permite alguma forma de proposta iniciada por cidadãos, enquanto todos os estados usam encaminhamentos legislativos de alguma forma.

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: Onde as iniciativas ciudadãs são permitidas, os apoiadores normalmente devem:

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **Apresentar uma petição** a um órgão estadual, incluindo frequentemente o texto exato da proposta.

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: **Receber um título e resumo oficial**, que é a linguagem que os eleitores verão eventualmente. Esta redação é por vezes objeto de disputas legais.

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **Coletar assinaturas** de eleitores registrados. O número necessário está frequentemente atrelado à participação em uma eleição anterior, e alguns estados também exigem que as assinaturas sejam distribuídas por regiões.

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **Passar pela verificação**, na qual os oficiais eleitorais verificam as assinaturas e a medida pode enfrentar revisão judicial antes de ser certificada.

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: Devido a esse processo, as campanhas geralmente começam mais de um ano antes do Dia da Eleição.

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: As campanhas de coleta de assinaturas podem ser dispendiosas, e os desafios legais sobre a redação, o assunto ou a validade das assinaturas podem decidir se uma proposta aparece na cédula.

segments.tr: Pemungutan suara dapat menaikkan upah minimum, mengubah cara pajak dikumpulkan, menulis ulang aturan pemilu, atau mengubah konstitusi negara bagian, dan hasilnya sering kali memiliki efek yang lebih langsung pada kehidupan sehari-hari daripada satu kursi di legislatif.

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## Apa Itu Pemungutan Suara Kebijakan?

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: Pemungutan suara kebijakan adalah pertanyaan yang diajukan langsung kepada pemilih daripada kepada pejabat yang dipilih.

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: Bergantung pada negara bagiannya, ini mungkin disebut sebagai proposisi, pertanyaan, amendemen, atau referendum.

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: Kata-katanya berbeda, tetapi tujuannya sama: suara "ya" atau "tidak" dapat mengubah undang-undang atau konstitusi negara bagian.

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: Pemungutan suara umumnya terbagi ke dalam beberapa kategori:

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **Undang-undang inisiatif warga:** Warga mengusulkan undang-undang baru, mengumpulkan cukup tanda tangan agar memenuhi syarat, dan pemilih menyetujui atau menolaknya.

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **Amendemen konstitusi inisiatif warga:** Warga mengusulkan perubahan pada konstitusi negara bagian melalui proses pengumpulan tanda tangan yang sama, di negara bagian yang mengizinkannya.

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **Rujukan legislatif:** Badan legislatif memasukkan usulan undang-undang atau amendemen konstitusi ke dalam surat suara. Di sebagian besar negara bagian, amendemen konstitusi harus disetujui pemilih sebelum mulai berlaku.

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **Referendum hak veto:** Warga mengumpulkan tanda tangan untuk menanyakan kepada pemilih apakah undang-undang yang telah disahkan oleh badan legislatif harus tetap berlaku.

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Kebijakan Masuk ke Surat Suara

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: Aturannya sangat bervariasi dari satu negara bagian ke negara bagian lainnya.

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: Kira-kira separuh negara bagian mengizinkan beberapa bentuk inisiatif warga, sementara setiap negara bagian menggunakan rujukan legislatif dalam beberapa bentuk.

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: Di tempat di mana inisiatif warga diizinkan, para pendukung biasanya harus:

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **Mengajukan petisi** ke kantor negara bagian, seringkali menyertakan teks persis dari proposal tersebut.

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: 2. **Menerima judul dan ringkasan resmi**, yang merupakan bahasa yang akhirnya akan dilihat oleh pemilih. Kata-kata ini terkadang menjadi subjek perselisihan hukum.

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **Mengumpulkan tanda tangan** dari pemilih terdaftar. Jumlah yang diperlukan sering kali dikaitkan dengan tingkat partisipasi dalam pemilu sebelumnya, dan beberapa negara bagian juga mengharuskan tanda tangan disebar di berbagai wilayah.

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **Lulus verifikasi**, di mana pejabat pemilu memeriksa tanda tangan dan kebijakan tersebut mungkin menghadapi tinjauan pengadilan sebelum disahkan.

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: Karena proses ini, kampanye sering kali dimulai lebih dari setahun sebelum Hari Pemilu.

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: Penggalangan tanda tangan bisa mahal, dan tantangan hukum atas kata-kata, subjek, atau keabsahan tanda tangan dapat menentukan apakah suatu kebijakan benar-benar muncul di surat suara.

segments.src: ## The Issues Voters Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## Isu-Isu yang Dipertimbangkan Pemilih

segments.src: Ballot measures tend to cluster around a handful of recurring subjects.
segments.tr: Pemungutan suara cenderung berpusat pada beberapa subjek yang berulang.

segments.src: Several categories are common in many election cycles.
segments.tr: Beberapa kategori umum dalam banyak siklus pemilu.

segments.src: ### Wages and Workplace Rules
segments.tr: ### Upah dan Aturan Tempat Kerja

segments.src: Minimum wage proposals have appeared on ballots in many states, along with questions about paid sick leave and tipped-worker pay.
segments.tr: Proposal upah minimum telah muncul dalam surat suara di banyak negara bagian, bersama dengan pertanyaan tentang cuti sakit berbayar dan pembayaran pekerja pemberi tips.

segments.src: Because wage rules affect household budgets and business costs at the same time, these measures draw attention from both employees and employers.
segments.tr: Karena aturan upah memengaruhi anggaran rumah tangga dan biaya bisnis secara bersamaan, kebijakan ini menarik perhatian dari karyawan maupun pemberi kerja.

segments.src: ### Taxes and Budgets
segments.tr: ### Pajak dan Anggaran

segments.src: Voters are frequently asked to approve or reject changes to property, income or sales taxes, to set limits on government spending, or to authorize bonds for schools, roads and other public projects.
segments.tr: Pemilih sering kali diminta untuk menyetujui atau menolak perubahan pajak properti, pendapatan, atau penjualan, menetapkan batas pengeluaran pemerintah, atau mengesahkan obligasi untuk sekolah, jalan, dan proyek publik lainnya.

segments.src: These questions often come with detailed fiscal analyses prepared by nonpartisan state agencies.
segments.tr: Pertanyaan-pertanyaan ini sering kali disertai dengan analisis fiskal terperinci yang disiapkan oleh lembaga negara bagian nonpartisan.

segments.src: ### Election Rules
segments.tr: ### Aturan Pemilu

segments.src: Some of the most closely watched measures concern the process of voting itself.
segments.tr: Beberapa kebijakan yang paling banyak disorot berkaitan dengan proses pemungutan suara itu sendiri.

segments.src: Topics have included voter identification requirements, ranked-choice voting, open primaries, redistricting commissions and campaign finance rules.
segments.tr: Topiknya meliputi persyaratan identifikasi pemilih, pemungutan suara pilihan berperingkat, pemilihan pendahuluan terbuka, komisi penataan ulang daerah pemilihan, dan aturan keuangan kampanye.

segments.src: Since these measures set the framework for future elections, they can shape which candidates compete and how votes are counted.
segments.tr: Karena kebijakan ini menetapkan kerangka kerja untuk pemilu masa depan, kebijakan ini dapat menentukan kandidat mana yang bersaing dan bagaimana suara dihitung.

segments.src: ### Other Policy Areas
segments.tr: ### Bidang Kebijakan Lainnya

segments.src: Housing, health care, public safety, education funding and environmental policy also regularly appear.
segments.tr: Perumahan, layanan kesehatan, keselamatan publik, pendanaan pendidikan, dan kebijakan lingkungan juga secara teratur muncul.

segments.src: Individual states may also present highly local questions that never become national news.
segments.tr: Masing-masing negara bagian juga dapat menyajikan pertanyaan yang sangat lokal yang tidak pernah menjadi berita nasional.

segments.src: ## Why These Measures Can Matter as Much as Any Candidate
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Kebijakan Ini Bisa Sangat Berarti Seperti Kandidat Mana Pun

segments.src: A single legislator is one vote among many.
segments.tr: Seorang anggota legislatif tunggal adalah satu suara di antara banyak suara.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, can become law or a constitutional provision on its own once voters approve it.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, pemungutan suara kebijakan dapat menjadi undang-undang atau ketentuan konstitusional dengan sendirinya setelah pemilih menyetujuinya.

segments.src: That has several consequences:
segments.tr: Hal itu memiliki beberapa konsekuensi:

segments.src: - **Direct and durable change.** A constitutional amendment can be difficult to undo, since reversing it often requires another statewide vote.
segments.tr: - **Perubahan langsung dan bertahan lama.** Amendemen konstitusi bisa sulit untuk dibatalkan, karena membalikkannya seringkali membutuhkan pemungutan suara tingkat negara bagian lainnya.

segments.src: - **Policy outside the legislature.** Voters can act on topics that lawmakers have been unwilling or unable to address, or can reject proposals the legislature has passed.
segments.tr: - **Kebijakan di luar badan legislatif.** Pemilih dapat bertindak atas topik yang tidak ingin atau tidak dapat ditangani oleh pembuat undang-undang, atau dapat menolak proposal yang telah disahkan oleh badan legislatif.

segments.src: - **Influence on turnout.** High-profile measures can motivate people to vote who might otherwise skip a midterm election.
segments.tr: - **Pengaruh terhadap partisipasi pemilih.** Kebijakan profil tinggi dapat memotivasi orang untuk memilih yang mungkin jika tidak akan melewatkan pemilu paruh waktu.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Successful measures in one state are often studied and copied by advocates in others.
segments.tr: - **Efek riak.** Kebijakan yang berhasil di satu negara bagian seringkali dipelajari dan ditiru oleh para advokat di negara bagian lain.

segments.src: ## How to Prepare as a Voter
segments.tr: ## Cara Mempersiapkan Diri sebagai Pemilih

segments.src: Ballot measures can be dense, and the wording is not always easy to follow.
segments.tr: Pemungutan suara bisa rumit, dan kata-katanya tidak selalu mudah dipahami.

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: Beberapa kebiasaan ini membantu:

segments.src: - **Read the full text and the official summary,** not just the title. Official voter guides, usually published by the secretary of state or election office, include the exact language and arguments for and against.
segments.tr: - **Baca teks lengkap dan ringkasan resminya,** bukan hanya judulnya. Panduan pemilih resmi, yang biasanya diterbitkan oleh sekretaris negara bagian atau kantor pemilu, menyertakan bahasa yang tepat serta argumen untuk dan menentang.

segments.src: - **Check the fiscal analysis.** Many states publish independent estimates of what a measure would cost or save.
segments.tr: - **Periksa analisis fiskal.** Banyak negara bagian menerbitkan perkiraan independen tentang berapa biaya atau penghematan dari suatu kebijakan.

segments.src: - **Understand what "yes" and "no" mean.** On some measures, a "yes" vote keeps current law while a "no" vote changes it, or the reverse. The wording can be counterintuitive.
segments.tr: - **Pahami arti "ya" dan "tidak".** Pada beberapa kebijakan, suara "ya" mempertahankan undang-undang saat ini sementara suara "tidak" mengubahnya, atau sebaliknya. Kata-katanya bisa jadi berlawanan dengan intuisi.

segments.src: - **Look at who is funding each side.** State campaign finance databases list major donors for and against a measure.
segments.tr: - **Lihat siapa yang mendanai setiap kubu.** Database keuangan kampanye negara bagian mencantumkan donor utama yang mendukung dan menentang suatu kebijakan.

segments.src: - **Use trusted, nonpartisan sources.** Local newsrooms, nonpartisan research organizations and official state publications can help separate the facts from campaign advertising.
segments.tr: - **Gunakan sumber yang terpercaya dan nonpartisan.** Ruang berita lokal, organisasi riset nonpartisan, dan publikasi resmi negara bagian dapat membantu memisahkan fakta dari iklan kampanye.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote the whole ballot.** Some voters leave ballot questions blank, a practice known as "ballot roll-off." Reviewing a sample ballot ahead of time can make it easier to decide.
segments.tr: - **Buat rencana untuk memilih seluruh surat suara.** Beberapa pemilih meninggalkan pertanyaan dalam surat suara dalam keadaan kosong, sebuah praktikke yang dikenal sebagai "ballot roll-off". Meninjau contoh surat suara terlebih dahulu dapat mempermudah keputusan.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: Campaign coverage naturally focuses on candidates, but the ballot is often much longer than the headlines suggest.
segments.tr: Liputan kampanye secara alami berfokus pada kandidat, tetapi surat suara seringkali jauh lebih panjang daripada yang disarankan oleh tajuk utama.

segments.src: Taking time to learn about the questions that appear on your own ballot is one of the most direct ways to have a say in the rules, taxes and policies that affect your state.
segments.tr: Meluangkan waktu untuk mempelajari pertanyaan-pertanyaan yang muncul pada surat suara Anda sendiri adalah salah satu cara paling langsung untuk memiliki suara dalam aturan, pajak, dan kebijakan yang memengaruhi negara bagian Anda.

segments.src: Check your local election office for a sample ballot and voter guide, and confirm your registration status and voting options well before Election Day.
segments.tr: Periksa kantor pemilu lokal Anda untuk mendapatkan contoh surat suara dan panduan pemilih, serta konfirmasikan status pendaftaran dan pilihan suara Anda jauh sebelum Hari Pemilu.

ja.title: 候補者の向こう側: 11月の州住民投票が政策を形作る仕組み

segments.src: When Americans head to the polls in November, the biggest names on the ticket will be candidates for the Senate, the House and governor's offices.
segments.tr: 11月にアメリカ人が投票所に向かうとき、投票用紙の最上部に並ぶのは上院、下院、そして知事選の候補者たちです。

segments.src: But look further down the ballot and many voters will find something different: questions that ask them to decide a policy directly.
segments.tr: しかし、投票用紙の下の方に目を向ければ、多くの有権者は異なるものを見つけるでしょう。それは政策を直接決定することを求める質問です。

segments.src: Ballot measures can raise the minimum wage, change how taxes are collected, rewrite election rules or amend a state constitution, and the outcomes often have a more immediate effect on daily life than a single seat in a legislature.
segments.tr: 住民投票によって最低賃金の引き上げ、税金の徴収方法の変更、選挙ルールの書き換え、あるいは州憲法の改正が可能であり、その結果は多くの場合、議会の1議席よりも日常生活に対してより直接的な影響を及ぼします。

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## 住民投票とは何か？

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: 住民投票とは、選出された公職者ではなく、有権者に直接問いかけられる質問のことです。

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: 州によって、プロポジション（提案）、クエスチョン（質問）、アメンドメント（修正案）、あるいはレファレンダム（住民投票）と呼ばれることがあります。

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: 表現は異なりますが、その理念は同じです。「賛成」または「反対」の投票によって、法律や州憲法を変更することができるのです。

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: 住民投票は一般的にいくつかのカテゴリーに分類されます：

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **住民発議の制定法（Initiated statutes）：** 市民が新しい法律を提案し、資格を得るのに十分な署名を集め、有権者がそれを承認または拒否します。

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **住民発議の憲法修正案（Initiated constitutional amendments）：** それを認めている州において、市民が同じ署名プロセスを通じて州憲法の変更を提案します。

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **議会発議（Legislative referrals）：** 議会が法案または憲法修正案を投票用紙に載せます。ほとんどの州では、憲法修正案は発効する前に有権者の承認を得なければなりません。

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **拒否権住民投票（Veto referendums）：** 議会がすでに可決した法律をそのまま有効に存続させるべきかどうかを有権者に問うため、市民が署名を集めます。

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## 住民投票が投票用紙に載るまでの仕組み

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: ルールは州によって大きく異なります。

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: 州のおおむね半分が市民発議の何らかの形式を認めており、すべての州が何らかの形で議会発議を利用しています。

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: 市民発議が認められている場所では、支持者は通常、次のことを行う必要があります：

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **請願書を提出する：** 州の当局に対して行い、多くの場合、提案の正確な条文が含まれます。

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: 2. **公式のタイトルと要約を受け取る：** これは最終的に有権者が目にする文言です。この表現は法的な争いの対象になることもあります。

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **有権者から署名を集める：** 必要な数は前回の選挙の投票率に関連付けられていることが多く、州によっては地域全体にわたって署名を集めることを義務付けているところもあります。

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **検証を通過する：** 選挙管理官が署名をチェックし、認定される前に法廷闘争に直面することもあります。

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: このようなプロセスのため、キャンペーンは選挙日の1年以上前から始まることがよくあります。

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: 署名集めには多額の費用がかかることがあり、文言、主題、または署名の有効性をめぐる法的な異議申し立てによって、提案が投票用紙に掲載されるかどうかが決まることもあります。

segments.src: ## The Issues Voters Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## 有権者が検討している課題

segments.tr: 多くの選挙サイクルにおいて、いくつかのカテゴリーが共通して見られます。

segments.src: ### Wages and Workplace Rules
segments.tr: ### 賃金と職場のルール

segments.src: Minimum wage proposals have appeared on ballots in many states, along with questions about paid sick leave and tipped-worker pay.
segments.tr: 最低賃金の提案は多くの州の投票用紙に登場しており、有給病気休暇やチップを受け取る労働者の給与に関する質問も含まれています。

segments.src: Because wage rules affect household budgets and business costs at the same time, these measures draw attention from both employees and employers.

segments.tr: ### 税金と予算

segments.src: Voters are frequently asked to approve or reject changes to property, income or sales taxes, to set limits on government spending, or to authorize bonds for schools, roads and other public projects.
segments.tr: 有権者は、固定資産税、所得税、売上税の変更の承認または拒否、政府支出に制限の設定、あるいは学校、道路、その他の公共事業のための地方債の承認を頻繁に求められます。

segments.src: ### Election Rules
segments.tr: ### 選挙ルール

segments.src: Topics have included voter identification requirements, ranked-choice voting, open primaries, redistricting commissions and campaign finance rules.

segments.tr: これらの住民投票は将来の選挙の枠組みを定めるため、どの候補者が競争し、どのように票が数えられるかを形作ることができます。

segments.src: ### Other Policy Areas
segments.tr: ### その他の政策分野

segments.src: Housing, health care, public safety, education funding and environmental policy also regularly appear.
segments.tr: 住宅、医療、公共の安全、教育の資金調達、環境政策も定期的に登場します。

segments.src: ## Why These Measures Can Matter as Much as Any Candidate
segments.tr: ## これらの住民投票がどの候補者にも劣らず重要になり得る理由

segments.src: A single legislator is one vote among many.
segments.tr: 一人の議員は数ある票のうちの一票に過ぎません。

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, can become law or a constitutional provision on its own once voters approve it.
segments.tr: 対照的に、住民投票は、有権者が承認すればそれだけで法律や憲法上の規定になることができます。

segments.src: That has several consequences:
segments.tr: それにはいくつかの結果が伴います：

segments.src: - **Direct and durable change.** A constitutional amendment can be difficult to undo, since reversing it often requires another statewide vote.
segments.tr: - **直接的かつ持続的な変化。** 憲法修正案を覆すには別の州全体での投票が必要になることが多いため、元に戻すのが難しい場合があります。

segments.src: - **Policy outside the legislature.** Voters can act on topics that lawmakers have been unwilling or unable to address, or can reject proposals the legislature has passed.
segments.tr: - **議会を通さない政策。** 有権者は、法律制定者が取り組む意思を持たなかった、あるいは取り組むことができなかったトピックについて行動を起こすことができ、または議会が可決した提案を拒否することができます。

segments.src: - **Influence on turnout.** High-profile measures can motivate people to vote who might otherwise skip a midterm election.
segments.tr: - **投票率への影響。** 注目の高い住民投票は、そうでなければ中間選挙をパスするかもしれない人々に投票する動機を与えることができます。

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Successful measures in one state are often studied and copied by advocates in others.
segments.tr: - **波及効果。** ある州で成功した住民投票は、他の州の擁護者たちによってしばしば研究され、模倣されます。

segments.src: ## How to Prepare as a Voter
segments.tr: ## 有権者として準備する方法

segments.src: Ballot measures can be dense, and the wording is not always easy to follow.
segments.tr: 住民投票は内容が複雑で、文言を理解するのが必ずしも容易ではない場合があります。

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: いくつかの習慣が役立ちます：

segments.src: - **Read the full text and the official summary,** not just the title. Official voter guides, usually published by the secretary of state or election office, include the exact language and arguments for and against.
segments.tr: - **タイトルだけでなく、全文と公式の要約を読む。** 通常、州務長官や選挙管理事務所によって発行される公式の有権者ガイドには、正確な文言と、賛成および反対の議論が含まれています。

segments.src: - **Check the fiscal analysis.** Many states publish independent estimates of what a measure would cost or save.
segments.tr: - **財政分析を確認する。** 多くの州は、住民投票にどれだけのコストがかかるか、あるいはどれだけの節約になるかについての独立した試算を公表しています。

segments.src: - **Understand what "yes" and "no" mean.** On some measures, a "yes" vote keeps current law while a "no" vote changes it, or the reverse. The wording can be counterintuitive.
segments.tr: - **「賛成」と「反対」が何を意味するかを理解する。** 一部の住民投票では、「賛成」票が現在の法律を維持し、「反対」票がそれを変更するか、あるいはその逆になります。文言が直感に反することがあります。

segments.src: - **Look at who is funding each side.** State campaign finance databases list major donors for and against a measure.
segments.tr: - **どちらの側が資金を提供しているかを確認する。** 州の選挙資金データベースには、住民投票の賛成派および反対派の主要な寄付者がリストアップされています。

segments.src: - **Use trusted, nonpartisan sources.** Local newsrooms, nonpartisan research organizations and official state publications can help separate the facts from campaign advertising.
segments.tr: - **信頼できる非党派のソースを利用する。** 地元の報道機関、非党派の調査機関、公式の州の発行物は、事実をキャンペーンの広告から切り離すのに役立ちます。

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote the whole ballot.** Some voters leave ballot questions blank, a practice known as "ballot roll-off." Reviewing a sample ballot ahead of time can make it easier to decide.
segments.tr: - **すべての投票用紙に投票する計画を立てる。** 一部の有権者は住民投票の質問を空白のままにします。これは「バロット・ロールオフ」として知られる慣行です。事前にサンプル投票用紙を見直すことで、決定を下すのが容易になります。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 要点

segments.src: Campaign coverage naturally focuses on candidates, but the ballot is often much longer than the headlines suggest.
segments.tr: 選挙の報道は当然のことながら候補者に焦点を当てますが、投票用紙はヘッドラインが示唆するよりもはるかに長いことがよくあります。

segments.src: Taking time to learn about the questions that appear on your own ballot is one of the most direct ways to have a say in the rules, taxes and policies that affect your state.
segments.tr: 自身の投票用紙に掲載される質問について時間をかけて学ぶことは、あなたの州に影響を与えるルール、税金、政策に対して発言権を持つための最も直接的な方法の1つです。

segments.src: Check your local election office for a sample ballot and voter guide, and confirm your registration status and voting options well before Election Day.
segments.tr: 選挙日のかなり前に、地元の選挙管理事務所でサンプル投票用紙と有権者ガイドを確認し、登録状況や投票の選択肢を確認してください。

de.title: Jenseits der Kandidaten: Wie staatliche Volksabstimmungen im November die Politik gestalten

segments.src: When Americans head to the polls in November, the biggest names on the ticket will be candidates for the Senate, the House and governor's offices.
segments.tr: Wenn die US-Amerikaner im November an die Urnen gehen, sind die prominentesten Namen auf dem Stimmzettel Kandidaten für den Senat, das Repräsentantenhaus und das Gouverneursamt.

segments.src: But look further down the ballot and many voters will find something different: questions that ask them to decide a policy directly.
segments.tr: Doch wenn man weiter nach unten auf dem Stimmzettel schaut, finden viele Wähler etwas anderes: Fragen, bei denen sie direkt über eine politische Maßnahme entscheiden können.

segments.src: Ballot measures can raise the minimum wage, change how taxes are collected, rewrite election rules or amend a state constitution, and the outcomes often have a more immediate effect on daily life than a single seat in a legislature.
segments.tr: Volksabstimmungen können den Mindestlohn erhöhen, die Steuererhebung ändern, Wahlregeln umschreiben oder eine Staatsverfassung ändern, und die Ergebnisse haben oft direktere Auswirkungen auf den Alltag als ein einzelner Sitz in einem Parlament.

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## Was ist eine Volksabstimmung?

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: Eine Volksabstimmung ist eine Frage, die direkt den Wählern und nicht gewählten Amtsträgern vorgelegt wird.

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: Je nach Bundesstaat wird sie als Proposition, Question, Amendment oder Referendum bezeichnet.

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: Der Wortlaut unterscheidet sich, aber die Idee ist dieselbe: Ein „Ja“- oder „Nein“-Votum kann ein Gesetz oder die Verfassung eines Bundesstaates ändern.

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: Volksabstimmungen lassen sich im Allgemeinen in einige Kategorien einteilen:

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **Initiierte Gesetze (Initiated statutes):** Bürger schlagen ein neues Gesetz vor, sammeln genügend Unterschriften für die Zulassung, und die Wähler nehmen es an oder lehnen es ab.

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **Initiierte Verfassungsänderungen (Initiated constitutional amendments):** Bürger schlagen über denselben Unterschriftenprozess eine Änderung der Staatsverfassung vor, in Bundesstaaten, die dies zulassen.

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **Parlamentarische Vorlagen (Legislative referrals):** Das Parlament setzt ein vorgeschlagenes Gesetz oder eine Verfassungsänderung auf den Stimmzettel. In den meisten Bundesstaaten müssen Verfassungsänderungen den Wählern vorgelegt werden, bevor sie in Kraft treten.

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **Veto-Referenden (Veto referendums):** Bürger sammeln Unterschriften, um die Wähler zu fragen, ob ein vom Parlament bereits verabschiedetes Gesetz in Kraft bleiben soll.

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## Wie Maßnahmen auf den Stimmzettel gelangen

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: Die Regeln variieren von Bundesstaat zu Bundesstaat stark.

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: Ungefähr die Hälfte der Bundesstaaten erlaubt eine Form von bürgerinitiierten Maßnahmen, während jeder Bundesstaat in irgendeiner Form parlamentarische Vorlagen nutzt.

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: Dort, wo Bürgerinitiativen erlaubt sind, müssen Befürworter in der Regel:

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **Eine Petition einreichen** bei einer staatlichen Behörde, oft einschließlich des genauen Textes des Vorschlags.

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: 2. **Einen offiziellen Titel und eine Zusammenfassung erhalten**, die den Text darstellen, den die Wähler schließlich sehen werden. Dieser Wortlaut ist manchmal Gegenstand rechtlicher Streitigkeiten.

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **Unterschriften sammeln** von registrierten Wählern. Die erforderliche Anzahl ist oft an die Wahlbeteiligung bei einer früheren Wahl gekoppelt, und einige Bundesstaaten verlangen zudem, dass die Unterschriften über Regionen hinweg verteilt sind.

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **Die Verifizierung bestehen**, bei der Wahlbeamte die Unterschriften prüfen und die Maßnahme vor ihrer Zertifizierung möglicherweise einer gerichtlichen Überprüfung unterzogen wird.

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: Wegen dieses Prozesses beginnen Kampagnen oft mehr als ein Jahr vor dem Wahltag.

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: Unterschriftensammlungen können kostspielig sein, und rechtliche Anfechtungen bezüglich des Wortlauts, des Inhalts oder der Gültigkeit der Unterschriften können darüber entscheiden, ob eine Maßnahme überhaupt auf dem Stimmzettel erscheint.

segments.src: ## The Issues Voters Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## Die Themen, die Wähler abwägen

segments.src: Ballot measures tend to cluster around a handful of recurring subjects.
segments.tr: Volksabstimmungen neigen dazu, sich um eine Handvoll wiederkehrender Themen zu scharen.

segments.src: Several categories are common in many election cycles.
segments.tr: Mehrere Kategorien sind in vielen Wahlzyklen üblich.

segments.src: ### Wages and Workplace Rules
segments.tr: ### Löhne und Arbeitsplatzregeln

segments.src: Minimum wage proposals have appeared on ballots in many states, along with questions about paid sick leave and tipped-worker pay.
segments.tr: Mindestlohnvorschläge sind in vielen Bundesstaaten auf Stimmzetteln erschienen, zusammen mit Fragen zu bezahltem Urlaub im Krankheitsfall und der Bezahlung von Beschäftigten mit Trinkgeld.

segments.src: Because wage rules affect household budgets and business costs at the same time, these measures draw attention from both employees and employers.
segments.tr: Da Lohnregeln Haushaltsbudgets und Geschäftskosten gleichzeitig beeinflussen, ziehen diese Maßnahmen die Aufmerksamkeit sowohl von Arbeitnehmern als auch von Arbeitgebern auf sich.

segments.src: ### Taxes and Budgets
segments.tr: ### Steuern und Budgets

segments.src: Voters are frequently asked to approve or reject changes to property, income or sales taxes, to set limits on government spending, or to authorize bonds for schools, roads and other public projects.
segments.tr: Wähler werden häufig aufgefordert, Änderungen bei Grund-, Einkommen- oder Verbrauchssteuern zu billigen oder abzulehnen, Obergrenzen für die Staatsausgaben festzulegen oder Anleihen für Schulen, Straßen und andere öffentliche Projekte zu genehmigen.

segments.src: These questions often come with detailed fiscal analyses prepared by nonpartisan state agencies.
segments.tr: Diese Fragen gehen oft mit detaillierten steuerlichen Analysen einher, die von überparteilichen staatlichen Stellen erstellt wurden.

segments.src: ### Election Rules
segments.tr: ### Wahlregeln

segments.src: Some of the most closely watched measures concern the process of voting itself.
segments.tr: Einige der am genauesten beobachteten Maßnahmen betreffen den Wahlprozess selbst.

segments.src: Topics have included voter identification requirements, ranked-choice voting, open primaries, redistricting commissions and campaign finance rules.
segments.tr: Die Themen umfassten Anforderungen an den Wählerschweis, Rangfolgenwahl (Ranked-Choice Voting), offene Vorwahlen, Kommissionen zur Neugestaltung der Wahlkreise und Regeln für die Wahlkampffinanzierung.

segments.src: Since these measures set the framework for future elections, they can shape which candidates compete and how votes are counted.
segments.tr: Da diese Maßnahmen den Rahmen für zukünftige Wahlen festlegen, können sie prägen, welche Kandidaten antreten und wie Stimmen ausgezählt werden.

segments.src: ### Other Policy Areas
segments.tr: ### Andere Politikbereiche

segments.src: Housing, health care, public safety, education funding and environmental policy also regularly appear.
segments.tr: Wohnungsbau, Gesundheitswesen, öffentliche Sicherheit, Bildungsfinanzierung und Umweltpolitik tauchen ebenfalls regelmäßig auf.

segments.src: Individual states may also present highly local questions that never become national news.
segments.tr: Einzelne Bundesstaaten können auch sehr lokale Fragen präsentieren, die niemals zu nationalen Nachrichten werden.

segments.src: ## Why These Measures Can Matter as Much as Any Candidate
segments.tr: ## Warum diese Maßnahmen genauso wichtig sein können wie jeder Kandidat

segments.src: A single legislator is one vote among many.
segments.tr: Ein einzelner Abgeordneter ist eine Stimme unter vielen.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, can become law or a constitutional provision on its own once voters approve it.
segments.tr: Eine Volksabstimmung hingegen kann von selbst zu einem Gesetz oder einer Verfassungsbestimmung werden, sobald die Wähler sie billigen.

segments.src: That has several consequences:
segments.tr: Das hat mehrere Konsequenzen:

segments.src: - **Direct and durable change.** A constitutional amendment can be difficult to undo, since reversing it often requires another statewide vote.
segments.tr: - **Direkte und dauerhafte Änderung.** Eine Verfassungsänderung kann schwer rückgängig zu machen sein, da eine Aufhebung oft eine weitere landesweite Abstimmung erfordert.

segments.src: - **Policy outside the legislature.** Voters can act on topics that lawmakers have been unwilling or unable to address, or can reject proposals the legislature has passed.
segments.tr: - **Politik außerhalb des Parlaments.** Wähler können zu Themen aktiv werden, die Gesetzgeber nicht angehen wollten oder konnten, oder Vorschläge ablehnen, die das Parlament verabschiedet hat.

segments.src: - **Influence on turnout.** High-profile measures can motivate people to vote who might otherwise skip a midterm election.
segments.tr: - **Einfluss auf die Wahlbeteiligung.** Prominente Maßnahmen können Menschen motivieren wählen zu gehen, die sonst eine Halbzeitwahl (Midterm) auslassen würden.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Successful measures in one state are often studied and copied by advocates in others.
segments.tr: - **Wellenwirkungen (Ripple effects).** Erfolgreiche Maßnahmen in einem Bundesstaat werden oft von Befürwortern in anderen studiert und kopiert.

segments.src: ## How to Prepare as a Voter
segments.tr: ## Wie man sich als Wähler vorbereitet

segments.src: Ballot measures can be dense, and the wording is not always easy to follow.
segments.tr: Volksabstimmungen können komplex sein, und der Wortlaut ist nicht immer leicht nachzuvollziehen.

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: Ein paar Gewohnheiten helfen:

segments.src: - **Read the full text and the official summary,** not just the title. Official voter guides, usually published by the secretary of state or election office, include the exact language and arguments for and against.
segments.tr: - **Den vollständigen Text und die offizielle Zusammenfassung lesen,** nicht nur den Titel. Offizielle Wählerführer, die in der Regel vom Secretary of State oder dem Wahlbüro veröffentlicht werden, enthalten den genauen Wortlaut sowie Argumente dafür und dagegen.

segments.src: - **Check the fiscal analysis.** Many states publish independent estimates of what a measure would cost or save.
segments.tr: - **Die Haushaltsanalyse prüfen.** Viele Bundesstaaten veröffentlichen unabhängige Schätzungen darüber, was eine Maßnahme kosten oder einsparen würde.

segments.src: - **Understand what "yes" and "no" mean.** On some measures, a "yes" vote keeps current law while a "no" vote changes it, or the reverse. The wording can be counterintuitive.
segments.tr: - **Verstehen, was „Ja“ und „Nein“ bedeuten.** Bei einigen Maßnahmen behält ein „Ja“-Votum das aktuelle Gesetz bei, während ein „Nein“-Votum es ändert, oder umgekehrt. Der Wortlaut kann kontraintuitiv sein.

segments.src: - **Look at who is funding each side.** State campaign finance databases list major donors for and against a measure.
segments.tr: - **Darauf schauen, wer jede Seite finanziert.** Die Datenbanken zur staatlichen Wahlkampffinanzierung führen Großspender für und gegen eine Maßnahme auf.

segments.src: - **Use trusted, nonpartisan sources.** Local newsrooms, nonpartisan research organizations and official state publications can help separate the facts from campaign advertising.
segments.tr: - **Vertrauenswürdige, überparteiliche Quellen nutzen.** Lokale Redaktionen, überparteiliche Forschungsorganisationen und offizielle staatliche Publikationen können helfen, die Fakten von der Wahlwerbung zu trennen.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote the whole ballot.** Some voters leave ballot questions blank, a practice known as "ballot roll-off." Reviewing a sample ballot ahead of time can make it easier to decide.
segments.tr: - **Einen Plan machen, um den gesamten Stimmzettel auszufüllen.** Einige Wähler lassen Fragen auf dem Stimmzettel leer, eine Praxis, die als „Ballot Roll-off“ bekannt ist. Das Vorab-Überprüfen eines Musterstimmzettels kann die Entscheidung erleichtern.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: Campaign coverage naturally focuses on candidates, but the ballot is often much longer than the headlines suggest.
segments.tr: Die Berichterstattung über Kampagnen konzentriert sich natürlich auf Kandidaten, aber der Stimmzettel ist oft viel länger, als die Schlagzeilen vermuten lassen.

segments.src: Taking time to learn about the questions that appear on your own ballot is one of the most direct ways to have a say in the rules, taxes and policies that affect your state.
segments.tr: Sich die Zeit zu nehmen, etwas über die Fragen zu lernen, die auf Ihrem eigenen Stimmzettel erscheinen, ist einer der direktesten Wege, um ein Mitspracherecht bei den Regeln, Steuern und Richtlinien zu haben, die Ihren Bundesstaat betreffen.

segments.src: Check your local election office for a sample ballot and voter guide, and confirm your registration status and voting options well before Election Day.
segments.tr: Informieren Sie sich in Ihrem lokalen Wahlbüro über einen Musterstimmzettel und Wählerleitfaden und bestätigen Sie Ihren Registrierungsstatus und Ihre Wahlmöglichkeiten rechtzeitig vor dem Wahltag.

vi.title: Ngoài các ứng cử viên: Đề xuất cử tri bang định hình chính sách như thế nào vào tháng 11

segments.src: When Americans head to the polls in November, the biggest names on the ticket will be candidates for the Senate, the House and governor's offices.
segments.tr: Khi người Mỹ đi bỏ phiếu vào tháng 11, những cái tên lớn nhất trên phiếu bầu sẽ là các ứng cử viên cho Thượng viện, Hạ viện và văn phòng thống đốc.

segments.src: But look further down the ballot and many voters will find something different: questions that ask them to decide a policy directly.
segments.tr: Nhưng hãy nhìn sâu hơn xuống phía dưới phiếu bầu và nhiều cử tri sẽ thấy một điều khác biệt: các câu hỏi yêu cầu họ quyết định trực tiếp một chính sách.

segments.src: Ballot measures can raise the minimum wage, change how taxes are collected, rewrite election rules or amend a state constitution, and the outcomes often have a more immediate effect on daily life than a single seat in a legislature.
segments.tr: Các biện pháp bỏ phiếu có thể nâng mức lương tối thiểu, thay đổi cách thu thuế, viết lại các quy định bầu cử hoặc sửa đổi hiến pháp tiểu bang, và kết quả thường có tác động trực tiếp hơn đến cuộc sống hàng ngày so với một ghế duy nhất trong cơ quan lập pháp.

segments.src: ## What Is a Ballot Measure?
segments.tr: ## Biện pháp bỏ phiếu là gì?

segments.src: A ballot measure is a question put directly to voters rather than to elected officials.
segments.tr: Một biện pháp bỏ phiếu là một câu hỏi được đưa trực tiếp cho cử tri thay vì các quan chức đắc cử.

segments.src: Depending on the state, it might be called a proposition, a question, an amendment or a referendum.
segments.tr: Tùy thuộc vào tiểu bang, nó có thể được gọi là một đề xuất, một câu hỏi, một sửa đổi hoặc một cuộc trưng cầu dân ý.

segments.src: The wording differs, but the idea is the same: a "yes" or "no" vote can change a law or a state's constitution.
segments.tr: Cách diễn đạt khác nhau, nhưng ý tưởng là giống nhau: một phiếu "có" hoặc "không" có thể thay đổi luật hoặc hiến pháp của tiểu bang.

segments.src: Ballot measures generally fall into a few categories:
segments.tr: Các biện pháp bỏ phiếu thường được chia thành một vài loại:

segments.src: - **Initiated statutes:** Citizens propose a new law, gather enough signatures to qualify, and voters approve or reject it.
segments.tr: - **Đạo luật do công dân đề xuất:** Công dân đề xuất một đạo luật mới, thu thập đủ chữ ký để đủ điều kiện, và cử tri chấp thuận hoặc bác bỏ nó.

segments.src: - **Initiated constitutional amendments:** Citizens propose a change to the state constitution through the same signature process, in states that allow it.
segments.tr: - **Sửa đổi hiến pháp do công dân đề xuất:** Công dân đề xuất thay đổi hiến pháp tiểu bang thông qua quy trình thu thập chữ ký tương tự, ở các tiểu bang cho phép điều đó.

segments.src: - **Legislative referrals:** The legislature places a proposed law or constitutional amendment on the ballot. In most states, constitutional amendments must go to voters before they take effect.
segments.tr: - **Sự chuyển tiếp của cơ quan lập pháp:** Cơ quan lập pháp đưa một dự luật hoặc sửa đổi hiến pháp được đề xuất lên phiếu bầu. Ở hầu hết các tiểu bang, các sửa đổi hiến pháp phải được đưa đến cử tri trước khi có hiệu lực.

segments.src: - **Veto referendums:** Citizens collect signatures to ask voters whether a law the legislature has already passed should stay in effect.
segments.tr: - **Trưng cầu dân ý phủ quyết:** Công dân thu thập chữ ký để hỏi cử tri xem một luật mà cơ quan lập pháp đã thông qua có nên tiếp tục có hiệu lực hay không.

segments.src: ## How Measures Get on the Ballot
segments.tr: ## Các biện pháp xuất hiện trên phiếu bầu như thế nào

segments.src: The rules vary widely from state to state.
segments.tr: Các quy tắc rất khác nhau giữa các tiểu bang.

segments.src: Roughly half of the states allow some form of citizen-initiated measure, while every state uses legislative referrals in some form.
segments.tr: Khoảng một nửa số tiểu bang cho phép một số hình thức biện pháp do công dân khởi xướng, trong khi mọi tiểu bang đều sử dụng các chuyển tiếp lập pháp dưới một hình thức nào đó.

segments.src: Where citizen initiatives are allowed, supporters typically must:
segments.tr: Nơi các sáng kiến của công dân được phép, những người ủng hộ thường phải:

segments.src: 1. **File a petition** with a state office, often including the exact text of the proposal.
segments.tr: 1. **Nộp đơn kiến nghị** với cơ quan tiểu bang, thường bao gồm văn bản chính xác của đề xuất.

segments.src: 2. **Receive an official title and summary**, which is the language voters will eventually see. This wording is sometimes the subject of legal disputes.
segments.tr: 2. **Nhận tiêu đề và bản tóm tắt chính thức**, đây là ngôn ngữ mà cử tri cuối cùng sẽ thấy. Cách diễn đạt này đôi khi là chủ đề của các tranh chấp pháp lý.

segments.src: 3. **Collect signatures** from registered voters. The required number is often tied to turnout in a previous election, and some states also require signatures to be spread across regions.
segments.tr: 3. **Thu thập chữ ký** từ các cử tri đã đăng ký. Số lượng yêu cầu thường gắn liền với tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu trong một cuộc bầu cử trước đó, và một số tiểu bang cũng yêu cầu chữ ký phải được phân bổ trên các khu vực.

segments.src: 4. **Pass verification**, in which election officials check signatures and the measure may face court review before it is certified.
segments.tr: 4. **Vượt qua khâu xác minh**, trong đó các quan chức bầu cử kiểm tra chữ ký và biện pháp này có thể phải đối mặt với việc xem xét của tòa án trước khi được chứng nhận.

segments.src: Because of this process, campaigns often start more than a year before Election Day.
segments.tr: Do quy trình này, các chiến dịch thường bắt đầu hơn một năm trước Ngày Bầu cử.

segments.src: Signature drives can be costly, and legal challenges over wording, subject matter or signature validity can decide whether a measure appears on the ballot at all.
segments.tr: Các chiến dịch thu thập chữ ký có thể tốn kém, và các thách thức pháp lý về cách diễn đạt, chủ đề hoặc tính hợp lệ của chữ ký có thể quyết định liệu một biện pháp có xuất hiện trên phiếu bầu hay không.

segments.src: ## The Issues Voters Are Weighing
segments.tr: ## Các vấn đề cử tri đang cân nhắc

segments.src: Ballot measures tend to cluster around a handful of recurring subjects.
segments.tr: Các biện pháp bỏ phiếu có xu hướng tập trung quanh một số ít các chủ đề lặp đi lặp lại.

segments.src: Several categories are common in many election cycles.
segments.tr: Một số loại phổ biến trong nhiều chu kỳ bầu cử.

segments.src: ### Wages and Workplace Rules
segments.tr: ### Tiền lương và Quy tắc nơi làm việc

segments.src: Minimum wage proposals have appeared on ballots in many states, along with questions about paid sick leave and tipped-worker pay.
segments.tr: Các đề xuất lương tối thiểu đã xuất hiện trên phiếu bầu ở nhiều tiểu bang, cùng với các câu hỏi về nghỉ ốm có lương và tiền lương của nhân viên nhận tiền boa.

segments.src: Because wage rules affect household budgets and business costs at the same time, these measures draw attention from both employees and employers.
segments.tr: Vì các quy tắc tiền lương ảnh hưởng đến ngân sách hộ gia đình và chi phí doanh nghiệp cùng một lúc, các biện pháp này thu hút sự chú ý từ cả nhân viên và người sử dụng lao động.

segments.src: ### Taxes and Budgets
segments.tr: ### Thuế và Ngân sách

segments.src: Voters are frequently asked to approve or reject changes to property, income or sales taxes, to set limits on government spending, or to authorize bonds for schools, roads and other public projects.
segments.tr: Cử tri thường xuyên được yêu cầu phê duyệt hoặc từ chối các thay đổi đối với thuế tài sản, thu nhập hoặc doanh thu, thiết lập giới hạn chi tiêu của chính phủ, hoặc ủy quyền trái phiếu cho các trường học, đường xá và các dự án công cộng khác.

segments.src: These questions often come with detailed fiscal analyses prepared by nonpartisan state agencies.
segments.tr: Những câu hỏi này thường đi kèm với các phân tích tài chính chi tiết được chuẩn bị bởi các cơ quan phi đảng phái của tiểu bang.

segments.src: ### Election Rules
segments.tr: ### Quy tắc bầu cử

segments.src: Some of the most closely watched measures concern the process of voting itself.
segments.tr: Một số biện pháp được theo dõi sát sao nhất liên quan đến chính quá trình bỏ phiếu.

segments.src: Topics have included voter identification requirements, ranked-choice voting, open primaries, redistricting commissions and campaign finance rules.
segments.tr: Các chủ đề bao gồm yêu cầu nhận dạng cử tri, bỏ phiếu theo thứ hạng ưu tiên, bầu cử sơ bộ mở, ủy ban phân chia lại khu vực bầu cử và các quy tắc tài chính chiến dịch.

segments.src: Since these measures set the framework for future elections, they can shape which candidates compete and how votes are counted.
segments.tr: Vì các biện pháp này thiết lập khuôn khổ cho các cuộc bầu cử trong tương lai, chúng có thể định hình những ứng cử viên nào tranh cử và cách phiếu bầu được kiểm đếm.

segments.src: ### Other Policy Areas
segments.tr: ### Các lĩnh vực chính sách khác

segments.src: Housing, health care, public safety, education funding and environmental policy also regularly appear.
segments.tr: Nhà ở, chăm sóc sức khỏe, an toàn công cộng, tàifunding giáo dục và chính sách môi trường cũng thường xuyên xuất hiện.

segments.src: Individual states may also present highly local questions that never become national news.
segments.tr: Các tiểu bang riêng lẻ cũng có thể đưa ra các câu hỏi mang tính địa phương cao mà không bao giờ trở thành tin tức quốc gia.

segments.src: ## Why These Measures Can Matter as Much as Any Candidate
segments.tr: ## Tại sao các biện pháp này có thể quan trọng như bất kỳ ứng cử viên nào

segments.src: A single legislator is one vote among many.
segments.tr: Một nhà lập pháp duy nhất chỉ là một phiếu bầu trong số nhiều người.

segments.src: A ballot measure, by contrast, can become law or a constitutional provision on its own once voters approve it.
segments.tr: Ngược lại, một biện pháp bỏ phiếu có thể trở thành luật hoặc điều khoản hiến pháp một cách độc lập ngay sau khi cử tri phê duyệt nó.

segments.src: That has several consequences:
segments.tr: Điều đó mang lại một số hệ quả:

segments.src: - **Direct and durable change.** A constitutional amendment can be difficult to undo, since reversing it often requires another statewide vote.
segments.tr: - **Thay đổi trực tiếp và lâu dài.** Một sửa đổi hiến pháp có thể khó đảo ngược, vì việc đảo ngược nó thường đòi hỏi một cuộc bỏ phiếu khác trên toàn tiểu bang.

segments.src: - **Policy outside the legislature.** Voters can act on topics that lawmakers have been unwilling or unable to address, or can reject proposals the legislature has passed.
segments.tr: - **Chính sách bên ngoài cơ quan lập pháp.** Cử tri có thể hành động về các chủ đề mà các nhà lập pháp không sẵn lòng hoặc không thể giải quyết, hoặc có thể từ chối các đề xuất mà cơ quan lập pháp đã thông qua.

segments.src: - **Influence on turnout.** High-profile measures can motivate people to vote who might otherwise skip a midterm election.
segments.tr: - **Ảnh hưởng đến tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu.** Các biện pháp nổi bật có thể thúc đẩy những người đi bầu mà nếu không họ có thể bỏ qua một cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ.

segments.src: - **Ripple effects.** Successful measures in one state are often studied and copied by advocates in others.
segments.tr: - **Hiệu ứng lan tỏa.** Các biện pháp thành công ở một tiểu bang thường được nghiên cứu và sao chép bởi các nhà vận động ở các tiểu bang khác.

segments.src: ## How to Prepare as a Voter
segments.tr: ## Cách chuẩn bị với tư cách là một cử tri

segments.src: Ballot measures can be dense, and the wording is not always easy to follow.
segments.tr: Các biện pháp bỏ phiếu có thể phức tạp, và cách diễn đạt không phải lúc nào cũng dễ hiểu.

segments.src: A few habits help:
segments.tr: Một số thói quen sẽ giúp ích:

segments.src: - **Read the full text and the official summary,** not just the title. Official voter guides, usually published by the secretary of state or election office, include the exact language and arguments for and against.
segments.tr: - **Đọc toàn bộ văn bản và bản tóm tắt chính thức,** chứ không chỉ tiêu đề. Hướng dẫn cử tri chính thức, thường được xuất bản bởi bộ trưởng ngoại giao hoặc văn phòng bầu cử, bao gồm ngôn ngữ chính xác và các lập luận ủng hộ cũng như phản đối.

segments.src: - **Check the fiscal analysis.** Many states publish independent estimates of what a measure would cost or save.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm tra phân tích tài chính.** Nhiều tiểu bang công bố các ước tính độc lập về chi phí hoặc số tiền tiết kiệm được từ một biện pháp.

segments.src: - **Understand what "yes" and "no" mean.** On some measures, a "yes" vote keeps current law while a "no" vote changes it, or the reverse. The wording can be counterintuitive.
segments.tr: - **Hiểu ý nghĩa của "có" và "không".** Đối với một số biện pháp, một phiếu "có" giữ nguyên luật hiện hành trong khi phiếu "không" thay đổi nó, hoặc ngược lại. Cách diễn đạt có thể đi ngược lại trực giác.

segments.src: - **Look at who is funding each side.** State campaign finance databases list major donors for and against a measure.
segments.tr: - **Xem xét ai đang tài trợ cho mỗi bên.** Cơ sở dữ liệu tài chính chiến dịch của tiểu bang liệt kê các nhà tài trợ lớn ủng hộ và phản đối một biện pháp.

segments.src: - **Use trusted, nonpartisan sources.** Local newsrooms, nonpartisan research organizations and official state publications can help separate the facts from campaign advertising.
segments.tr: - **Sử dụng các nguồn tin cậy, phi đảng phái.** Các phòng tin tức địa phương, các tổ chức nghiên cứu phi đảng phái và các ấn phẩm chính thức của tiểu bang có thể giúp tách biệt các sự thật khỏi quảng cáo tranh cử.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote the whole ballot.** Some voters leave ballot questions blank, a practice known as "ballot roll-off." Reviewing a sample ballot ahead of time can make it easier to decide.
segments.tr: - **Lên kế hoạch bỏ phiếu cho toàn bộ phiếu bầu.** Một số cử tri bỏ trống các câu hỏi trên phiếu bầu, một thực tế được gọi là "bỏ phiếu không hết". Xem xét trước một phiếu mẫu có thể giúp việc quyết định dễ dàng hơn.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: Campaign coverage naturally focuses on candidates, but the ballot is often much longer than the headlines suggest.
segments.tr: Đưa tin về chiến dịch tranh cử đương nhiên tập trung vào các ứng cử viên, nhưng phiếu bầu thường dài hơn nhiều so với những gì các tiêu đề gợi ý.

segments.src: Taking time to learn about the questions that appear on your own ballot is one of the most direct ways to have a say in the rules, taxes and policies that affect your state.
segments.tr: Dành thời gian tìm hiểu về các câu hỏi xuất hiện trên phiếu bầu của chính bạn là một trong những cách trực tiếp nhất để có tiếng nói trong các quy tắc, thuế và chính sách ảnh hưởng đến tiểu bang của bạn.

segments.src: Check your local election office for a sample ballot and voter guide, and confirm your registration status and voting options well before Election Day.
segments.tr: Kiểm tra văn phòng bầu cử địa phương của bạn để có phiếu mẫu và hướng dẫn cử tri, đồng thời xác nhận tình trạng đăng ký và các lựa chọn bỏ phiếu của bạn trước Ngày Bầu cử.
